programme_name_es: Master Universitario en Aplicaciones Educativas de la Inteligencia Artificial
city: Logrono (sede social, Av. de la Paz 137, 26006 Logrono); teaching is 100% online
official_status: master universitario (OFFICIAL). Registered in RUCT as 'Master Universitario en Aplicaciones Educativas de la Inteligencia Artificial'. Estado: Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACION RENOVADA POR ACREDITACION INSTITUCIONAL). Nivel academico: Master - RD 822/2021 (3). Nivel MECES: 3. Rama: Ciencias Sociales y Juridicas. Fecha de verificacion: 25/02/2026. BOE publication dates: 24/06/2026. Accreditation: Resolucion Favorable Acreditacion Institucional (17/09/2020). The programme page itself carries the words 'Titulo Oficial' in its status bar, links to its own RUCT record (CodigoEstudio=3500967) and publishes the full ANECA/Consejo de Universidades document set (Memoria, Informe favorable ANECA, Resolucion de verificacion, publicacion BOE/BOR del plan de estudios). This is NOT a titulo propio / master de formacion permanente - UNIR sells both and the status bar prints which one each page is.
modality: online ('Online interactivo' per the programme status bar; the ANECA Memoria records PRESENCIAL = No, SEMIPRESENCIAL/HIBRIDA = No, A DISTANCIA/VIRTUAL = Si). Exams: 'Online y/o presenciales' - the student chooses per subject and per convocatoria between sitting at home and sitting at a UNIR-authorised exam centre.
language_of_instruction: Castellano (Spanish) only
language_requirement: NOT FOUND - no language certificate requirement is published for this programme. NOTE the practical consequence for this candidate: teaching, materials, live classes and assessment are in Spanish, and the candidate is at A0/A1 with B1-B2 only possible by Sept 2027. A Spanish-taught 60-ECTS master is a real language risk here.
tuition_year_of_rates: NOT FOUND - no rate and no rate-year is published
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND. Checked explicitly on four pages: the programme page (no price and no fee table at all), the university fees page 'Becas universitarias y tasas', the general 'Requisitos de acceso' page and the 'Acceso para alumnos internacionales' page (Anexo 3 del Reglamento de Acceso y Admision). None of them mentions any differential, non-EU, non-resident or international rate - but none of them publishes any rate at all, so silence here is NOT evidence that no surcharge exists. Per the brief this is NOT FOUND, never 'no'. A human must ask an asesor for a written quote.
entry_requirements: RD 822/2021 art. 18 general access incl. the non-EHEA route without homologacion (equivalence checked by UNIR). Specific criteria - at least ONE of: (1) an affine degree, i.e. 'titulados universitarios en Pedagogia, Psicopedagogia, Psicologia, Educacion Social, Maestro en Educacion Infantil o Maestro en Educacion Primaria', or a Master Universitario in the education sciences field (Psicopedagogia, Neuropsicologia y Educacion, Formacion del Profesorado), 'o titulaciones que puedan ser consideradas equivalentes, por su plan de estudios, por la comision de admisiones; en estos casos el estudiante debera entregar informacion que demuestre que se han cursado y superado las materias que permiten adquirir un perfil competencial similar'; (2) demonstrable professional experience of at least one full academic year (or 9 months) teaching in formal or non-formal education. Admission decided by the Comision de Admisiones (title lead + Responsable de Acceso y Verificaciones).
accepts_engineering_background: NO / DOUBTFUL - and NOT explicit either way. Software Engineering is not on the affine-degree list, which is entirely education/psychology. The only opening is the discretionary 'titulaciones equivalentes por su plan de estudios' clause, which would require the applicant to evidence education-sciences coursework he does not have, or 9+ months of teaching experience. Do not rank this as an AI/ML master for this profile: the AI content is pedagogy-applied, not technical.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (null). The Memoria's 'CREDITOS DE COMPLEMENTOS FORMATIVOS' cell is BLANK. No applicant-level complementos published; the gate is a degree-field / teaching-experience test instead.
credit_recognition_available: Per-title cap document NOT PUBLISHED. General UNIR rules apply. UNIR-wide rules (Reconocimiento de creditos page + Normativa RTC): the prior study ('estudio de reconocimiento') is free and must be requested up to 10 days before matriculation; recognisable inputs are any official university study, expertos/cursos universitarios >110 h, CEFR B1+ language certificates, Ciclos Formativos de Grado Superior, and accredited professional experience. CRITICAL FOR COST: 'NOTA: Para los estudios de Master, los alumnos abonaran la matricula completa del Master y estaran eximidos de pagar por el Reconocimiento y Transferencia de los creditos' - i.e. at master level recognition does NOT reduce what you pay. No UNIR rule was found that gives advanced standing for a 300-ECTS / 5-year first degree specifically; the 300-ECTS surplus is not addressed anywhere on UNIR's published pages.
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND (2027-28 calendar not published as of 2026-08-25)
application_rounds: 2026-27 cycle, current convocatoria label shown on the page: 'Convocatoria Actual: 16 mar 2026' | Next published intake START date for this programme: 19 oct 2026 (2026-27). Status bar reads 'Abierta proxima convocatoria' / 'Plazas limitadas'. | Academic calendar for the Oct/Nov 2026 intake runs to a TFM ordinary deposit of 21/07/2027 and an extraordinary deposit of 22/09/2027 (calendar PDF for the 2026-2027 course). | 2027-28 convocatoria dates: NOT PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25
non_eu_early_round_advised: NOT FOUND as published advice. Structural observation, not a sourced claim: because the programme is 100% online there is no student-visa/residence step to time an application around; the binding constraints are instead the UNIR equivalence check on the Tunisian degree and (where applicable) the choice of an authorised exam centre. A human should confirm both with an asesor.
admissions_contact_email: info@unir.net (general admissions; the page also gives +34 941 209 743). becas@unir.net and tel. +34 941 890 143 for the scholarships office.
curriculum_summary: Cuatrimestre 1 (Obligatoria, 6 ECTS each): Inteligencia Artificial en Educacion: Modelos, Enfoques e Innovacion Pedagogica; Del Dato a la Accion Educativa con Inteligencia Artificial; Inteligencia Artificial Generativa en Contextos Educativos; Creacion de Contenidos Educativos con Inteligencia Artificial; Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial para la Inclusion, Diversidad y la Accesibilidad. Cuatrimestre 2: Inteligencia Artificial Aplicada a la Gestion Docente (6, Obl); Etica, Proteccion y Privacidad de Datos en el Uso de la Inteligencia Artificial (6, Obl); Proyecto de Aplicacion Practica para el Diseno de Entornos de Aprendizaje con Inteligencia Artificial (6, Obl); Trabajo Fin de Master (12).
notable_faculty_or_lab: NOT FOUND on the pages read this pass.
industry_links: NOT FOUND.
thesis_or_internship: TFM 12 ECTS. No practicas externas.

CUATRIMESTRE 1 (30 ECTS): MATERIA 1 FORMACIÓN BÁSICA — 3 compulsory 6-ECTS subjects: Bioseñales y bioimágenes; Aprendizaje automático; Tratamiento estadístico de señales. MATERIA 2 MÉTODOS Y HERRAMIENTAS PARA INTELIGENCIA COMPUTACIONAL — choose 2 of: Aprendizaje profundo (6), Tratamiento de imágenes biomédicas (6), Optimización (6). CUATRIMESTRE 2 (30 ECTS): MATERIA 3 IMÁGENES MÉDICAS Y VISIÓN POR ORDENADOR (min 6 ECTS) — Reconstrucción de imágenes médicas (6), Imágenes y navegación quirúrgica (3), Neuroimagen (3), Visión por ordenador (6), Inteligencia Artificial en radiología y microscopía (3). MATERIA 4 APRENDIZAJE MÁQUINA EN SALUD (min 6 ECTS) — Teoría de la información para el aprendizaje automático (6), Aprendizaje Automático Probabilístico y Generativo (6), Procesado del Lenguaje Natural (6), Medicina personalizada (3), Tecnologías del habla para salud (3). MATERIA 5 MÉTODOS DE INVESTIGACIÓN — Metodologías de Investigación (3, obligatoria). MATERIA 6 TRABAJO FIN DE MÁSTER (9). Rule verbatim: 'Para completar los 30 ETCS del Cuatrimestre 2 los estudiantes deberán elegir un total de 18 ECTS entre las asignaturas de las materias 3 y 4, eligiendo un mínimo de 6 ECTS en cada materia.' ⚠️ AUDIO/SIGNAL RELEVANCE (paths A/B/C): this is the only programme in the batch with a SIGNAL-PROCESSING SPINE that a music-technology candidate can actually use — 'Tratamiento estadístico de señales' (compulsory, 6 ECTS) and the optional 'Tecnologías del habla para salud' (3 ECTS, speech technology) plus 'Procesado del Lenguaje Natural' (6). The domain is health, not music, so it is an AA record with transferable DSP/ML-for-audio content rather than a path-A/B programme.

THIS MASTER IS ANEXO II ('resto de másteres'): it is NOT named in the Anexo I list, so the rate is 84,07 €/crédito, +86.7% over the EU rate. THE RESIDENCY TRAP IS CLOSED EXPLICITLY: 'A estos efectos, la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real Decreto 557/2011 ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes' (SFS04229 PDF); the current web version cites the successor 'Real Decreto 1155/2024, de 19 de noviembre'. entry_requirements: Verbatim from the programme's Access & Admission page: 'students interested in taking the Master's Degree in Data Science must hold a degree in computer science: Bachelor of Science in Informatics Engineering; Bachelor of Science in Mathematics and Informatics; Bachelor of Science in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence; BACHELOR OF SCIENCE IN SOFTWARE ENGINEERING; Bachelor of Science in Information Systems; Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering; Bachelor of Science in Technologies for the Information Society — or alternatively, a related qualification: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics or Physics with a specialisation in Computing; Any degree developed in the field of engineering with a predominantly technological profile (biomedical, telecommunications, etc.).' Pre-registration runs through the HELIOS application. Selection, verbatim: 'The reference elements which will be considered by the Academic Board of the MSc (CAMCD) in the students' selection process are: the University where the student comes from, the studied degree and the student's academic record.' 40 places. UPM-wide rule for non-EHEA degrees, per the UPM master catalogue: graduates of systems outside the EHEA may be admitted without homologating their degree once the university verifies an equivalent level of training. Permanence rule: 'students must pass at least 15 ECTS during their first academic year, and at least 45 ECTS during the first two academic years of enrolment.'
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT YES — AND THE STRONGEST MATCH IN THE ENTIRE BATCH. 'Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering' is NAMED, word for word, in the list of degrees held to BE 'a degree in computer science' for this master. It is not a related/alternative category, it is inside the primary list. This is quoted, not inferred. Consequence: the candidate falls in the group that does NOT trigger training complements (see complementary_credits_required).
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) — RUCT 4316972 publishes 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos: 0' for the title. AT APPLICANT LEVEL, HOWEVER, THE PROGRAMME DOES OPERATE COMPLEMENTS, so RUCT's 0 is not the whole answer. Verbatim from the Access & Admission page: 'For new applicants with a degree that is not in the field of computer science but related to it, the training complements deemed necessary will be established (up to a maximum of 12 ECTS).' And, tied to the Euro-Inf label: 'The Master's Academic Committee (CAMCD), in order to ensure that all students whose entry profile is not from the field of Computer Science but related to it can achieve these objectives, will establish for these students up to a maximum of 12 ECTS of complementary training courses to be taken through subjects of the Degree in Computer Engineering (GII) or the Degree in Mathematics and Computer Science (GMI) taught at the ETS of Computer Engineering of the UPM.' The named complement courses are: 'Within the field of Programming: Programming I; Algorithms and Data Structures. From the field of Software Engineering, Information Systems, and Intelligent Systems: Data bases; Artificial Intelligence. From the field of Statistics: Probability and Statistics I; Probability and Statistics II.' Assignment is individual: 'The assignment of training complements is done on an individual basis for each student, for which all students will be asked to provide information on the computer science subjects they have studied in their related degrees and the contents of these courses. After assessing this information, the complementary courses to be taken will be identified, with a maximum of 12 ECTS.' Complements must be enrolled in the regular annual registration period. READ FOR THIS CANDIDATE: because 'Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering' is listed IN the computer-science group (not the 'related to it' group), the complements clause should NOT apply. That is a reading of the published rule, not an assurance — the assignment is individual and evidence-based, so the transcript will still be examined. I am QUOTING THE PROGRAMME PAGE for the applicant-level rule and RUCT for the title-level 0.
credit_recognition_available: Mechanism EXISTS and is documented, but no 300-ECTS-specific entitlement is published. Verbatim: 'All information regarding the recognition and transfer of credits is available here. The Academic Committee of the Master's Degree in Data Science (CAMCD) will assess the requests and draw up the corresponding reports, which will be sent to the Academic Organization Committee of the School of Computer Engineering, which in turn will issue a report and send it to the Vice-Rector's Office for Students. The resolution granting or denying the recognition of credits will be adopted by the President of the Credit Recognition and Transfer Committee in accordance with the provisions of art. 5 d) of the regulations.' So there IS a named, multi-stage route (CAMCD -> ETSIINF Academic Organization Committee -> Vice-Rectorate -> Credit Recognition and Transfer Committee) into which a 300-ECTS applicant can put a request, and UPM maintains a university-wide 'Reconocimiento de Créditos' section. What is NOT published anywhere is any automatic advanced standing, exemption or shortened path for an over-length (300 ECTS, 5-year) prior degree. THE 300-ECTS QUESTION IS THEREFORE: mechanism yes, entitlement NOT FOUND. Note the counter-pressure: the master is only 60 ECTS with 36 compulsory and a 12-ECTS TFM, leaving little that could plausibly be recognised.

curriculum_summary: Four pillars — S1 Fundamentals of Research; S2 Data Processing and Infrastructure; S3 Data Analysis and Exploitation; S4 Societal, Legal and Ethic aspects in Data Science. COMPULSORY (36 ECTS): M1 Introduction to Research Methodology (1,5); M2 Data Visualization (3); M3 Big Data (3); M4 Cloud Computing and Big Data Ecosystems (4,5); M5 Data Processes (4,5); M6 Statistical Data Analysis (4,5); M7 Machine Learning (4,5); M8 Deep Learning (3); M9 Open Data and Knowledge Graphs (4,5); M10 Societal, Legal and Ethic aspects in Data Science (3). ELECTIVES (12 ECTS chosen): O1 Programming for Data Processing (4,5); O2 Data Science Seminars (4,5); O3 Generative AI and Language Models (4,5, marked NEW); O4 Time series Data Mining (3); O5 Graph Analysis and Social Networks (3); O6 Image Processing, Analysis and Classification (4,5); O7 Information Retrieval, Extraction and Integration (4,5). TFM 12 ECTS. Teaching plan verbatim: 'The first semester starts in early September with the course Introduction to Research Methodology taught intensively for three afternoons... On the first semester, 7 mandatory courses and 1 elective course (Generative AI and Language Models) are offered. The second semester runs from February to April... The rest of the semester, until July, is devoted to the development of the Master's Final Project.' ⭐ RELEVANCE TO PATH AC (cloud/distributed): 'M4: Cloud Computing and Big Data Ecosystems (4,5 ECTS)' is COMPULSORY and its description is explicitly infrastructure-facing — 'This course presents traditional data management systems and architectures for scalable distributed systems and data management systems: bigtable, data streaming, persistent queues.' This is the only compulsory cloud/distributed-systems course in any of the data masters in this batch. ⭐ RELEVANCE TO PATHS A/B (music/audio): O4 Time series Data Mining explicitly names AUDIOMETRY among its domains ('medical domains such as Electrocardiography or Audiometry') and covers symbolic approaches to time series — the closest transferable hook to music information retrieval. M8 Deep Learning mentions speech understanding. Nothing music-specific.

Research exposure, verbatim: 'Students will have the opportunity to experience research activity with ETSIInf research groups and the UPM AI R+D+I center AI.nnovation Space.' Programme coordinator/contact: Arminda Moreno. Holds the EURO-INF international quality label (EQANIE).

thesis_or_internship: Trabajo Fin de Máster / Master's Final Project, 12 ECTS, developed from roughly April to July. Prácticas = 0 ECTS in RUCT; no compulsory internship. Topic assignment: agree directly with a teacher, or choose from a December file of MUCD professors' proposals (rank up to 5), or propose your own. Defence before a 3-lecturer panel, 20-40 minute presentation plus up to 20 minutes of questions, in person or online, in SPANISH OR ENGLISH. Honourable mention possible. The 12-ECTS TFM plus the compulsory research-methodology course make this a genuinely PhD-preparatory master (UPM: 'esta formación puede servir de base tanto para la posterior consecución del título de Doctor como para la incorporación del egresado a la actividad profesional').

entry_requirements: A CLOSED LIST — this is the most restrictive access rule in the batch. Verbatim: 'Podrán acceder al título, sin necesidad de complementos formativos, aquellos estudiantes que estén en disposición de un Grado en las siguientes titulaciones: Graduados en Ciencia de Datos e Inteligencia Artificial; Graduados en Ingeniería y Sistemas de Datos; GRADUADOS EN INGENIERÍA DEL SOFTWARE.; Graduados en Ingeniería Informática.; Graduados en Matemáticas e Informática; Graduados en Ing. Informática y Matemáticas; Graduados en Ingeniería de Computadores.; Graduados en Inteligencia Artificial'. IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWED BY, verbatim: 'Dado que la presente titulación de master tiene un enfoque muy especializado, se considera que los alumnos provenientes de otras titulaciones diferentes a las especificadas no cumplen con los requisitos mínimos para ser admitidos.' — i.e. there is NO discretionary route in for any other degree. General access, verbatim: 'Podrán acceder los titulados conforme a sistemas educativos ajenos al Espacio Europeo de Educación Superior, sin necesidad de la homologación de sus títulos, previa comprobación por la Universidad de que aquellos acreditan un nivel de formación equivalente a los correspondientes títulos universitarios oficiales españoles y que facultan en el país expedidor del título para el acceso a enseñanzas de posgrado.' DOCUMENTS, verbatim: 'El alumno deberá presentar un currículo, el expediente académico del título de grado que da acceso al máster, hasta tres cartas de recomendación y una carta de intenciones junto con el impreso de solicitud de admisión y la documentación acreditativa mencionada. La CAT podrá solicitar una entrevista con el solicitante.' RANKING WEIGHTS, verbatim: 'Nota media de la titulación (70%); Otra formación complementaria relacionada con las competencias del título (15%); Cartas de recomendación e intenciones (10%); Experiencia profesional (5%)'. 25 plazas only. NO ENTRANCE EXAM: 'No se contemplan condiciones o pruebas de acceso especiales para estudiar el máster' — though UPM's Normativa de Admisión art. 22 allows a centre to request one.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT YES — 'Graduados en Ingeniería del Software' is named verbatim in the closed access list, and named specifically as one of the degrees that enters 'SIN NECESIDAD DE COMPLEMENTOS FORMATIVOS'. This is the single most exact degree-name match in the batch for a Software Engineering graduate. Quoted, not inferred. ⚠️ BUT: the equivalence of a Tunisian 5-year SMU MedTech 'Software Engineering' degree to a Spanish 'Grado en Ingeniería del Software' is decided by UPM's own verification step, and given the closed-list wording ('no cumplen con los requisitos mínimos para ser admitidos' for anything else), that equivalence finding is the whole ballgame. Ask before applying.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) AND 0 AT APPLICANT LEVEL FOR THIS DEGREE — the two agree here, which is worth stating because they did not in other records in this batch. (1) RUCT (the TITLE): RUCT 4318376 publishes 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos: 0'. (2) THE PROGRAMME'S OWN ADMISSION PAGE (the APPLICANT): verbatim, 'Podrán acceder al título, SIN NECESIDAD DE COMPLEMENTOS FORMATIVOS, aquellos estudiantes que estén en disposición de un Grado en las siguientes titulaciones: ... Graduados en Ingeniería del Software. ...'. So for a Software Engineering graduate the answer is an explicit zero at BOTH levels. The corollary is harsh, however: the programme does not offer complementos as a bridge for anyone else. Instead of assigning bridging credits to a non-matching profile (as UC3M's Machine Learning for Health does, or as UPM's own Data Science master does with up to 12 ECTS), it simply refuses admission: 'se considera que los alumnos provenientes de otras titulaciones diferentes a las especificadas no cumplen con los requisitos mínimos para ser admitidos.'
credit_recognition_available: MOSTLY CLOSED — and this is the only programme in the batch that publishes an explicit recognition table, all of whose published rows are ZERO. Verbatim from the programme's 'Información sobre transferencia y reconocimiento de créditos' page: 'Reconocimiento de Créditos Cursados en Enseñanzas Superiores Oficiales no Universitarias — MÍNIMO 0 — MÁXIMO 0'; 'Reconocimiento de Créditos Cursados en Títulos Propios — MÍNIMO 0 — MÁXIMO 0'; 'Reconocimiento de Créditos Cursados por Acreditación de Experiencia Laboral y Profesional — MÍNIMO 0 — MÁXIMO 0'; and the conclusion 'El título, por lo tanto, no admite el Reconocimiento de Créditos Cursados en Enseñanzas Superiores Oficiales no Universitarias, ni por Títulos Propios, ni por la Acreditación de Experiencia Laboral y Profesional.' ⚠️ PRECISION MATTERS HERE: those three named categories are non-university higher education, títulos propios, and work experience. Recognition of credits from a prior OFFICIAL UNIVERSITY degree is NOT one of the rows published on that page, so it is NOT explicitly excluded — it is simply NOT ADDRESSED. THE 300-ECTS QUESTION IS THEREFORE: NOT FOUND, with a strongly restrictive surrounding posture. Given a 60-ECTS title of which 48 ECTS are compulsory and 12 are the TFM, there is in practice almost nothing that could be recognised. Do not read the three published zeros as an answer about a 300-ECTS university degree — that would be over-reading the source.
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND for 2027-28 — UPM publishes only the 2026-27 calendar at access date, headed verbatim 'Curso 2026/2027 — PRIMER PERIODO DE PREINSCRIPCIÓN (Las clases comienzan en septiembre 2026)'. THE 2026-27 DATES ARE RECORDED AS 2026-27 AND HAVE NOT BEEN SHIFTED FORWARD A YEAR. curriculum_summary: 16 compulsory 3-ECTS subjects (48 ECTS) + 12-ECTS TFM; no electives. 1er SEMESTRE: Análisis de Redes Sociales (Social Network Analysis); Computación Evolutiva y Bioinspirada (Evolutionary and Bioinspired Computing); Deep Learning para Visión Computacional; Diseño de Sistemas de Adquisición y Procesamiento Masivo de Datos (sensors, actuators, communications, data processing); Gestión de Sistemas de Datos Masivos (relational/non-relational models, heterogeneous stores, ETL, dashboards); Metodología y Técnicas de Investigación; Optimización Exacta y Aproximada (gradient descent, Lagrange multipliers, mathematical/linear/quadratic programming, metaheuristics); Procesamiento del Lenguaje Natural mediante Deep Learning (distributed representations, probabilistic models, sequence models, transformers); Seminarios; Visualización Avanzada de Datos. 2º SEMESTRE: Aprendizaje por Refuerzo y Técnicas Generativas (associative RL, deep RL, variational autoencoders, GANs); Aspectos Éticos, Legales y Sociales del Big Data y la IA (IP, GDPR, data and software licences, AI ethics); Modelos de Inteligencia Artificial para Series Temporales (seasonality, autocorrelation, statistical and deep models, RNNs); Optimización para Grandes Volúmenes de Datos (Map-Reduce, data-intensive computing frameworks, real-time streaming, CLOUD COMPUTING, computational resource management); Seguridad y Privacidad de Datos; Sistemas de Recomendación (collaborative, content-based and demographic filtering, recommenders in production). ⭐ RELEVANCE TO PATHS B / A (music AI): this is the strongest ML-for-music-adjacent syllabus in the batch on paper — generative techniques (VAEs, GANs), transformers for sequences, time-series deep models including RNNs, and a full RECOMMENDER SYSTEMS course, which is the industrial core of music information retrieval and streaming. ⭐ RELEVANCE TO PATH AC: 'Optimización para Grandes Volúmenes de Datos' explicitly covers Map-Reduce, streaming and 'Computación en la nube'. NONE OF IT IS ACCESSIBLE WITHOUT SPANISH.

modality: presencial — Canal Universitats (Generalitat de Catalunya) lists the delivery mode verbatim as "Face-to-face"; centre is Campus de la Comunicació Poblenou, Edifici Tànger, C. de Tànger 122-140, 08018 Barcelona
language_of_instruction: English. The Generalitat de Catalunya's official Canal Universitats programme entry is titled verbatim "M.Sc. in Sound and Music Computing (taught in English)" and its language field reads "English". This is a government register page, directly fetched, NOT the university's own (blocked) page and NOT a translated version of a Spanish page.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND — no explicit English certificate level (B2/C1/IELTS/TOEFL) could be confirmed; the SMC admission page is on www.upf.edu and returns 403 to every automated fetch.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 (the last year for which UPF's own non-EU credit price is confirmed). The 2026-27 and 2027-28 non-EU credit prices are NOT PUBLISHED / not confirmable — see notes.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — large, and it is the decisive cost fact for this programme. Catalonia's Decret 96/2026 (DOGC 9689, 18.6.2026) art. 1.5 does NOT fix a non-EU price; it authorises each university's consell social to set it: «Els consells socials de les universitats públiques ... poden establir el preu dels crèdits en qualsevol nivell d'estudis per als i les estudiants estrangers no residents que no siguin nacionals d'estats membres de la Unió Europea ni dels estats en els quals sigui aplicable el règim comunitari, sense que el preu corresponent pugui excedir el 100% del seu cost». The same article states that a Spanish long-stay study authorisation does not confer residence: «l'autorització d'estada de llarga durada per estudis, mobilitat d'estudiants, serveis de voluntariat o activitats formatives concedida als i les estudiants estrangers no equival a la condició de residents» — so this candidate cannot escape the surcharge by moving to Barcelona. UPF's own tariff page (www.upf.edu/web/masters/preus) states that for students from outside the EU the Consell Social approves the credit price annually and that for 2025-2026 it is 93,5 EUR per credit, versus the decree's 19,37 EUR/credit for EU/resident students in a non-habilitante master — a multiplier of roughly 4.8x. 93,50 x 60 = 5,610 EUR for the 60-ECTS master alone.
entry_requirements: An official undergraduate degree/diploma (bachelor's degree, degree in engineering or architecture, diplomas, technical engineering and technical architecture diplomas — or, for foreign qualifications, the equivalent qualification awarded by an accredited higher education institution), plus the academic transcript of the accredited official training with the average grade at the university of origin. Selection: "the excellence in the academic CV as related to the topics of the master is the most important aspect that is considered in the admission process"; the Motivation Letter is the second important element. 25 places offered (Canal Universitats).
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT — the stated admission requirement names "a degree in engineering" among the accepted qualifications, and the title sits in the RUCT rama "Ingeniería y Arquitectura", campo "Ingeniería informática y de sistemas". A Software Engineering degree is squarely in scope.
complementary_credits_required: TWO DIFFERENT ANSWERS, BOTH REAL, AND THE DISTINCTION MATTERS. (a) TITLE LEVEL: 0 (RUCT) — the register records Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos = 0, i.e. the verified title carries no compulsory bridging credits, and the 60 ECTS break down as 35 obligatorios + 5 optativos + 20 TFM. (b) APPLICANT LEVEL: UPF states on the SMC pages that students take the 60 ECTS "plus up to 50 credits of complementary credits from advanced undergraduate courses (extending the program to two years)", that "depending on the previous education and specific interests, the student might be required to take extra credits and extend the duration of the Master to two years", and that "the specific courses to take are decided between the tutor and the student in accordance with the student background and specialization desired". So complementos here are an individual admission/tutorial decision, not a title requirement — exactly the case the brief warns about. A conflicting figure of "up to 15" complementary credits also appears in the indexed UPF text (see conflicts). NEITHER page could be opened directly: www.upf.edu returns 403 to all automated fetching.
credit_recognition_available: NOT ESTABLISHED, and this is the single most important open question for this programme. The candidate's 300-ECTS 5-year Software Engineering degree is precisely the profile that ought to make complementos unnecessary — 300 ECTS exceeds the 240-ECTS bar by a full year — but no UPF page could be read that says a longer prior degree exempts the applicant, and no reconocimiento-de-créditos rule for this master could be confirmed. UPF does operate a general master's credit-recognition procedure ("Credit recognition — Master's Academic Secretary", https://www.upf.edu/en/web/secretaria-master/reconeixement-de-credits-academics), also 403-blocked. Financially the stakes are: 60 ECTS x 93,50 = 5,610 EUR if no complementos are imposed, versus up to 110 credits over two years if the maximum 50 are imposed. Whether complementary credits are charged at the same non-EU 93,50 EUR/credit rate is NOT stated anywhere reachable; if they are, the maximum case is 110 x 93,50 = 10,285 EUR plus a second year of living costs. A HUMAN MUST ASK THE SMC ADMISSIONS OFFICE DIRECTLY, in writing, before this programme can be costed.
application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED for the September 2027 (curso 2027-28) intake. For the 2026-27 cycle UPF opened applications on 14 November and ran FOUR rounds with deadlines 14 January / 4 March / 27 April / 5 June 2026. These are 2026-27 dates and are recorded as such; they are NOT shifted forward a year here. If the pattern holds, a 2027-28 cycle would open in November 2026 with a first deadline in mid-January 2027, but that is an expectation, not a published fact.
application_rounds: 2026-27 cycle (NOT 2027-28): applications opened 14 November; round deadlines 14 January 2026, 4 March 2026, 27 April 2026, 5 June 2026
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — EXPLICIT. UPF states: "International candidates are encouraged to apply in the first and second application periods to allow admitted candidates enough time to address visa issues and get their documents legalized." For a Tunisian applicant this means targeting the first (mid-January) deadline.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Aplicaciones y Gestión de la Ingeniería de Telecomunicación (MASTEAM)
programme_name_en: Master's degree in Applied Telecommunications and Engineering Management (MASTEAM)
institution: Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC) — Escola d'Enginyeria de Telecomunicació i Aeroespacial de Castelldefels (EETAC)
modality: presencial — "Face-to-face (mornings and afternoons, alternating by semester)"; full-time or part-time options are offered. Campus: EETAC, Baix Llobregat, Building C4.
language_of_instruction: English. The UPC catalogue page states the language of instruction verbatim as "English", and the programme's own site states it is "taught entirely in English". Both are UPC-owned domains and were fetched directly.
language_requirement: "Official English language certification – Level B2 or higher according to the CEFR" (verbatim from the programme's specific-requirements page). A certificate is required, not merely fluency.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — inferred but arithmetically solid: the UPC catalogue's EU figure of €1,162 is exactly 19,37 × 60, and 19,37 EUR/credit is the price Decret 96/2026 fixes for a non-habilitante master for curso 2026-2027. The page itself does not print a year, so this is an inference from the arithmetic, flagged as such.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — explicit and quantified on UPC's own catalogue page, which publishes two separate figures: "EU residents: €1,162" and "Non-EU residents: €2,700" for the same 60-ECTS master. That is 45,00 EUR/credit versus 19,37 EUR/credit, a surcharge of about 2.3x. UPC's general master's fees page independently states non-EU/non-resident students pay "€45 per credit" against €17.69–€19.37 for EU students. Legal basis: Decret 96/2026 art. 1.5 lets the consell social set the non-EU non-resident price up to 100% of cost, and states that a long-stay study authorisation «no equival a la condició de residents» — so this candidate pays the non-EU rate even after moving to Spain.
entry_requirements: Bachelor's or Technical Engineering degree in Telecommunications or ICT Engineering, specialising in Telecommunications Systems, Telematics, Electronic Systems, Audiovisual Systems or Science & Technologies of Telecommunications — or an MSc in those fields — obtained at an institution in the EHEA. Flexibility provision, quoted from the page: "With complementary coursework, other engineering degrees from EHEA or Telecommunications/ICT engineering degrees from outside EHEA" may be considered; an Admission Committee reviews applications and may recommend additional coursework to address gaps. Plus certified English B2. Places: 20 (September intake), 10 (February intake).
accepts_engineering_background: CONDITIONALLY, AND THIS IS THE CATCH. The default requirement is a Telecommunications/ICT engineering degree FROM THE EHEA. A Tunisian Software Engineering degree is neither telecommunications-specific nor from the EHEA, so it falls into the flexibility clause, which admits "Telecommunications/ICT engineering degrees from outside EHEA" WITH complementary coursework. Whether a Software Engineering degree counts as an ICT engineering degree for this purpose is an Admission Committee judgement and is NOT stated. Recorded as EXPLICIT-CONDITIONAL, not a clean yes.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) at title level — the register publishes Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos = 0 for 4315535 (60 ECTS = 15 obligatorios + 33 optativos + 12 TFM). BUT at APPLICANT level the programme explicitly reserves the right to impose them: entry for a non-EHEA or non-telecom engineering degree is available only "with complementary coursework", decided case by case by the Admission Committee. "The document does not specify the exact number of complementary credits required, leaving this determination to the Admission Committee's case-by-case review." For this candidate that is a live, unquantified cost and duration risk. NEEDS A HUMAN TO ASK THE COORDINATOR.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND as advanced standing. What the pages DO say is the reverse-direction point: graduates need a prior 240-ECTS bachelor's plus this 60-ECTS master to reach the 300 ECTS that EHEA doctoral admission requires. The candidate already holds 300 ECTS, which is relevant to PhD access but is NOT presented anywhere as grounds for reducing this master. No reconocimiento de créditos rule for a longer prior degree could be found.
application_window_2027: NOT PUBLISHED for the September 2027 intake; the UPC catalogue records pre-enrolment as "Currently closed" as at 2026-08-25. For the FALL SEMESTER 2026-2027 intake the published pre-enrolment period ran 1 March 2026 – 15 June 2026, with official admission resolutions published in July 2026. Recorded as 2026-27 dates and NOT shifted forward a year. The programme runs TWO intakes a year — Autumn (September) and Spring (February) — which gives a Sept-2027 applicant a fallback.
application_rounds: 2026-27 Fall Semester (NOT 2027-28): pre-enrolment 1 March 2026 – 15 June 2026; admission resolutions published July 2026 | Programme runs two intakes annually: Autumn Semester (starts September) and Spring Semester (starts February)
non_eu_early_round_advised: NOT STATED as a separate round, but the site maintains a dedicated page of "aspects that non-EU residents must also take into account", and the single pre-enrolment window closing 15 June with resolutions only in July leaves a tight visa runway for a September start. Apply at the opening of the window.
admissions_contact_email: eetac.mastertelecom@upc.edu (MASTEAM academic coordination); eetac.web@upc.edu and eetac.directora@upc.edu (school)
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS = 15 obligatorios + 33 optativos + 12 ECTS thesis (RUCT 4315535; the programme site gives the identical 15/33/12 split). Electives across two semesters cover 5G networks, IoT, Big Data, network security, optical communications and sensor technology. WEAK FIT FOR PATH C: no audio, acoustics or audio-DSP track is offered — "No explicit audio/acoustics/signal-processing tracks are mentioned" on the programme site, and the only audio-adjacent element is "Audiovisual Systems" appearing as an accepted INCOMING degree specialisation, not as taught content. Career outcomes name the audiovisual sector among ICT-driven industries. Rank this as a telecommunications-management master, not an audio-DSP one.
notable_faculty_or_lab: EETAC Castelldefels. NOT FOUND at individual level.
industry_links: Career outcomes named: network operations, telecommunications services, smart cities, data centres, and ICT-driven sectors "automotive, audiovisual, food, logistics, energy, finance, etc." No named partner companies found.
thesis_or_internship: Thesis: 12 ECTS master's thesis. No compulsory prácticas externas (RUCT: 0 ECTS).
conflicts: TUITION — TWO UPC-OWNED PAGES DISAGREE. The UPC central catalogue (https://www.upc.edu/en/masters/applied-telecommunications-and-engineering-management-masteam) publishes EU residents €1,162 and Non-EU residents €2,700 for the 60-ECTS master, i.e. 19,37 and 45,00 EUR per credit, with no year stated. The programme's own fees page (https://masteam.masters.upc.edu/en/admission/information/fees) publishes "€ 27.67 per ECTS credit" for EU students and "€ 53.33 per ECTS credit" for non-EU students, explicitly labelled academic year 2025-2026, giving 1-year totals of €2,057 (EU) and €3,597.03 (non-EU). Both are UPC domains and both were fetched directly. The catalogue figures match Decret 96/2026's 2026-27 price exactly (19,37 × 60 = 1,162,20); the sub-site figures do not match any 2026-27 decree price and appear to be a stale year. NOT resolved here — a human should confirm which applies to a 2027 entrant. | ADMINISTRATIVE FEES — the sub-site lists "€ 89.54 per semester" plus "1.12€ mandatory school insurance for those students with ages under 28" plus "€ 218.15" for the degree certificate, all under the 2025-2026 heading; the catalogue simply says its figures exclude non-teaching fees and degree-certificate costs. additional_fees_eur here = 89,54 × 2 + 1,12 + 218,15 = 398,35, carried from the sub-site and therefore subject to the same year uncertainty.

language_of_instruction: «Español» - the Universidad de Sevilla programme page gives Spanish as the language of instruction, and separately requires Spanish «nivel equivalente o superior al B2». No English-taught option. HARD BLOCKER at A0/A1.
language_requirement: Spanish at «nivel equivalente o superior al B2» stated on the programme page. No English certificate requirement found.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2025-26 rates, still in force (Decreto 98/2023 Anexo I as modified by Decreto 142/2025); no 2026-27 decree published as of 2026-08-25
non_eu_surcharge: no - Universidad de Sevilla states explicitly: «Como estudiante internacional, abonarás los mismos precios públicos que cualquier otra persona estudiante en la Universidad. El sistema de precios es igualitario y regulado por decreto autonómico, sin distinción por nacionalidad» (cat.us.es). NOTE the legal head-room: Decreto 98/2023 art. 3.2 says «El estudiantado extranjero ... que no sea residente en España abonará los precios ... No obstante, las universidades en que se matricule podrán establecer una variación en el precio de los créditos en cualquier nivel de estudios, sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del 100% del coste del servicio académico» - so a surcharge is authorised in Andalucía but US has not applied one and publishes the opposite.
entry_requirements: Preference bands published by the programme: HIGH - Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Grado en Ingeniería de la Salud, and the pre-Bologna Ingeniería en Informática / Ingeniería Técnica en Informática. MEDIUM - other engineering specialities (Industrial, Telecomunicación) or Administración y Dirección de Empresas. LOW - Matemáticas or Física, who must additionally prove software-development competence. Spanish B2 or above. 35 plazas. Classes Monday-Thursday 18:00-21:00, and the master may be spread over two years.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT and in the highest preference band - Grado en Ingeniería Informática heads the list. A Software Engineering degree is the intended profile.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT at title level (ects_complementos_formativos = null - not the same as 0). AT APPLICANT LEVEL the programme page states up to 18 additional ECTS of complementos may be required depending on the applicant's background, decided by the Comisión Académica. A computing-engineering graduate sits in the top preference band, where complementos are least likely, but the ruling is per applicant.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND - no statement on the programme page about reconocimiento de créditos or advanced standing for a 300-ECTS degree. The only related flexibility published is the option to spread the 60 ECTS over two years, which is the opposite of shortening.
application_window_2027: 2026-27 calendar (published; 2027-28 NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25). Fase 1, reserved for holders of a non-homologated foreign degree - THIS CANDIDATE'S ROUTE: solicitudes 13-29 January 2026. Fase 2: 17-26 June 2026. Fase 3: 8-15 September 2026. Dates are NOT shifted forward a year; the 2027-28 calendar is not out.
application_rounds: 2026-27 Fase 1 (exclusively for holders of a non-homologated foreign university degree): solicitudes 13-29/01/2026; 1a adjudicación 19/02; 2a 12/03; 3a 09/04 | 2026-27 Fase 2: solicitudes 17-26/06/2026 | 2026-27 Fase 3: solicitudes 08-15/09/2026

industry_links: NOT FOUND as named partners; RUCT records 0 ECTS of prácticas, and the evening timetable is aimed at working professionals.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Ciencia de Datos
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Data Science
language_of_instruction: «Lengua de docencia: Castellano» - the UV official data sheet gives Castellano as the single language of delivery. The English version of the site is a translation, not evidence of English teaching (rule 7). HARD BLOCKER at A0/A1.
language_requirement: «Para estudiantes de países de habla no hispana se requiere Acreditación B2 de español (a través de un Diploma de Español como Lengua Extranjera en un nivel de B2, o en su caso, prueba oral y escrita)». A DELE B2 in Spanish is therefore a formal admission requirement for this candidate. English at B1+ counts only as a minor admission merit (5% band).
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27. Anexo I item 2.2 of Decreto 101/2024 (DOGV 9913, 12/08/2024) sets «Estudios de máster no comprendidos en el grupo anterior» at 35,34 EUR/crédito, 1a matrícula; Decreto 122/2026, de 4 de agosto, del Consell modifies Decreto 101/2024 and keeps the enrolment prices frozen for curso 2026-2027. The UV programme sheet shows the same 35,34 / 70,68 pair.
non_eu_surcharge: YES - EXPLICIT AND DOUBLE. The UV official data sheet publishes two credit prices side by side: «Precio del crédito primera matrícula: 35.34€» and «Estudiantes extranjeros no UE: 70.68€». Legal base: Decreto 101/2024, de 2 de agosto, del Consell, art. 6.1 - «Al estudiantado extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea ..., se le aplicará el doble de los precios públicos establecidos en el anexo I ..., sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del cien por cien (100%) del coste del servicio académico». Art. 6.3 closes the escape route: «la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real decreto 557/2011 ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes» - a Spanish study visa does NOT make this candidate a resident. The 1.5x transitional rate in Disposición transitoria primera applied only to curso 2024-2025, so the full doubling applies now.
entry_requirements: «Se requiere formación previa de nivel grado o superior en áreas como: Matemáticas, Física, Ingenierías (Informática, Electrónica, Telecomunicación e Industriales), Economía, y Administración y Dirección de Empresas.» Candidates must show competence in mathematics and statistics, prior use of programming tools (R, C, Matlab, Python or similar) and knowledge of programming fundamentals and databases. 25 plazas. Admission is scored: adecuación al perfil de ingreso 50%, expediente académico 40%, experiencia profesional en análisis de datos 5%, otros méritos (titulaciones adicionales, idiomas B1+, seminarios) 5%. Spanish B2 accreditation required for applicants from non-Spanish-speaking countries.
accepts_engineering_background: EXPLICIT - «Ingenierías (Informática, ...)» is named in the recommended entry profile, and it is the 50%-weighted admission criterion.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) at title level - the register records ects_complementos_formativos = 0. AT APPLICANT LEVEL the programme states: «Aquellos cuya formación previa sea insuficiente en los conocimientos requeridos deberán cursar complementos formativos establecidos en la memoria del programa» (section 4.6 of the memoria), judged by the Comisión Académica on mathematics/statistics/programming competence. So RUCT's 0 does NOT guarantee an applicant is exempt - this is one of the cases the brief warns about. A Software Engineering graduate would normally clear the programming test; the maths/statistics component is the one to evidence.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND - no statement of advanced standing or reconocimiento de créditos for a 300-ECTS first degree on the programme, data-sheet or admission pages. The 300 ECTS is useful here only as surplus over the entry bar; the master remains 90 ECTS over two courses.
application_window_2027: 2026-27 calendar (published; 2027-28 NOT YET PUBLISHED as of 2026-08-25). Fase 1: 30 March - 21 April 2026, 23:59. Fase 2: 25 May - 16 June 2026, 14:00. Fase Extraordinaria: 22-31 July and 24 August - 2 September 2026, 23:59. Dates are NOT shifted forward a year - the September 2027 intake calendar is not out.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES, urgently. A holder of a degree from outside the EHEA that is not homologated must pay a 155,22 EUR «estudio de equivalencia» fee and, critically, «Obtaining the equivalence resolution is a requirement for the evaluation of the pre-enrolment application» - the application is not even assessed until the equivalence resolution is issued. A Tunisian degree holder must therefore enter in Fase 1 (the March-April window) to leave time for that resolution.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND - UV routes pre-enrolment queries through its «Support and Enquiries» web form rather than publishing an address. Programme director: Emilio Soria Olivas (ETSE-UV).
curriculum_summary: 90 ECTS over two academic years. RUCT breakdown: 65 obligatorios, 0 optativos, 10 prácticas externas, 15 TFM. Taught at the Escuela Técnica Superior de Ingeniería (ETSE-UV), Avenida de la Universitat s/n, 46100 Burjassot. The 10-ECTS compulsory external placement is unusual among Spanish data-science masters and is a real industry hook.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Director Emilio Soria Olivas (ETSE-UV; machine-learning / intelligent data analysis group IDAL). Escola Tècnica Superior d'Enginyeria.
industry_links: 10 ECTS of compulsory prácticas externas built into the title (RUCT), i.e. a mandatory company placement. Specific partner companies NOT FOUND on the pages read.
thesis_or_internship: Both: 10 ECTS prácticas externas + 15 ECTS Trabajo Fin de Máster.

HARD BLOCKER at A0/A1.
language_requirement: «Para estudiantes de fuera del ámbito educativo iberoamericano, la Comisión puede exigir un nivel B2 de castellano.» Spanish B2 is therefore discretionary-but-likely for a Tunisian applicant. Community languages at B2+ (e.g. English, French) count only as part of the 10% «otros méritos» band.

complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) at title level. credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND - no advanced-standing or reconocimiento de créditos statement for a 300-ECTS degree on the data sheet, profile or admission tabs.

UAH publishes the two prices side by side for curso 2026-27: «españoles y residentes: 2.736 €» versus «extracomunitarios no residentes: 5.079 €», i.e. +2.343 EUR (+85.6%) for this candidate. entry_requirements: «Titulados en Ingeniería, principalmente los titulados en Grados de Ingeniería Informática», or quantitative disciplines (Estadística, Matemáticas), or «Titulados en carreras relacionadas con Economía y Administración de Empresas». 30 plazas, with 5% reserved for applicants with a recognised disability of 33% or more. language_of_instruction: "Idioma: Español" — verbatim from the UM programme page header (Centro: Facultad de Informática / Tipo de enseñanza: Presencial / Idioma: Español / Duración: 40 semanas / Créditos ECTS: 60 / Plazas de nuevo ingreso: 12 / Interuniversitario: Universidad de Murcia (UMU) y Universidad de Santiago de Compostela (USC)). language_requirement: No language certificate requirement published. Competence T4 is only "Conocimiento de otras lenguas, sobre todo la inglesa" as a learning outcome, not an entry condition. Spanish is required in practice.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2023-24 rates (Decreto n.º 8/2024, de 1 de febrero, BORM 10/02/2024) — this is the price order UM's own matrícula page still links as at 2026-08-25; no newer decree is published there. Rates for 2026-27 / 2027-28 are NOT PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — CONFIRMED AND PINNED (this field previously read NOT FOUND and has been CORRECTED against source). Universidad de Murcia's own 'Precios públicos' rules page states verbatim: "Las y los estudiantes extranjeros no comunitarios no residentes y estudiantes visitantes que se matriculen por primera vez en la Universidad de Murcia deberán abonar los derechos de secretaría que correspondan, además de los precios por la prestación de servicios académicos universitarios calculados según lo indicado en el artículo 21, incrementados en un 20%." The uplift applies whether it is a first, second or subsequent enrolment. So UM DOES exercise the power the regional decree grants it — Decreto n.º 8/2024 (Región de Murcia) art. 6.5: "Las universidades podrán diferenciar el precio del crédito hasta cubrir el 100 por 100 de los costes de las enseñanzas universitarias de grado y máster cuando se trate de estudiantes extranjeros mayores de dieciocho años que no tengan la condición de residentes, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquéllos a quienes sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, sin perjuicio del principio de reciprocidad" — but it exercises it at +20 per cent, far below the 100-per-cent-of-cost ceiling that decree permits. THIS CANDIDATE IS CAUGHT BY IT: a Tunisian national with no prior Spanish residency is 'extranjero no comunitario no residente'. OLDER, DIFFERENT RULE STILL PUBLISHED ON THE SAME SITE (logged, not silently reconciled): a UM Consejo de Gobierno document of 28/09/2012 states that from curso 2013-2014 non-EU non-resident students "les serán de aplicación las tarifas fijadas para los estudiantes visitantes" (visiting-student tariffs) rather than a percentage uplift. The current rules page governs; the 2012 document is retained because it is still live on um.es and a human should ask postgrado@um.es which tariff is actually billed.
entry_requirements: Access: Spanish/EHEA degree giving access to master's, OR a non-EHEA degree without homologación provided the university first verifies an equivalent level of training (UM's Comprobación del nivel de formación equivalente procedure, to be requested BEFORE the admission process). Entry profile, verbatim: "El máster está destinado principalmente a graduados en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Física, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones y otras Ingenierías. También está enfocado a profesionales de empresa." Access degrees listed: Informática, Física, Matemáticas, Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica, Industriales, otras áreas de ciencias — "sin que exista prelación entre ellas". Programming prerequisite, verbatim: "Aunque no se asumen conocimientos previos en Tecnologías de Gestión y Análisis de Datos Masivos, se requiere que los solicitantes tengan competencias en programación básica y, en particular, en algún lenguaje programación (por ejemplo, C, Java, Fortran, Python o Matlab)." Only 12 new-entry places. Admission under the Reglamento de Postgrado Oficial de la UMU, decided by the Comisión Académica, prioritised on academic record.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT and emphatic. Ingeniería Informática is the first named target degree and the programming prerequisite is exactly this candidate's strength.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT — 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' = 0 for 4315427). No applicant-level complementos are imposed on a computing/engineering entrant; the only prerequisite stated is basic programming competence, which is satisfied.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND at programme level. UM runs a general 'Reconocimiento de créditos' service (https://www.um.es/web/estudios/utilidades/reconocimiento-creditos) and the price decree charges 25% of fees for recognised/convalidated credits, but no advanced-standing rule for a 300-ECTS 5-year foreign degree is published. NOTE the plan has no optional credits at all (42 obligatorias + 18 TFM), which leaves little room for recognition in practice.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. UM's published 2026-2027 master admission calendar (verbatim headings): Fase I - presentación de solicitudes 'Del 10 de marzo al 22 de abril'; Fase II 'Del 1 al 30 de junio'; Fase Extraordinaria 'Del 30 de julio al 3 de septiembre'. Provisional lists 30 April / 13 July / 8 September; definitive lists 12 May / 17 July / 11 September; matrícula 12-14 May / 17-20 July / 11-14 September.
application_rounds: 2026-27 Fase I: 10 March - 22 April 2026 | 2026-27 Fase II: 1 - 30 June 2026 | 2026-27 Fase Extraordinaria: 30 July - 3 September 2026
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — REQUIRED IN EFFECT. A holder of a non-homologated foreign degree must request the 'Comprobación del nivel de formación equivalente de estudios universitarios extranjeros ajenos al EEES' BEFORE the admission process ("deberán solicitar, con antelación al proceso de admisión"), resolved by the Comisiones de Ramas de Conocimiento. With only 12 places, Fase I (March-April) is the realistic target.

"El Máster tiene una orientación eminentemente investigadora."

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Investigación Musical
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Music Research
institution: Universidad de Murcia (Facultad de Educación) with the Conservatorio Superior de Música de Murcia
language_of_instruction: "Idioma: Español" — verbatim from the UM programme page header. SPANISH-ONLY. Competence CET 1 even specifies research "utilizando el idioma español".
language_requirement: No certificate requirement published. Spanish is required in substance.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2023-24 rates (Decreto n.º 8/2024, de 1 de febrero, BORM 10/02/2024), the order UM's matrícula page still links as at 2026-08-25. 2026-27 / 2027-28 rates NOT PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — CONFIRMED AND PINNED (this field previously read NOT FOUND and has been CORRECTED against source). Universidad de Murcia's own 'Precios públicos' rules page states verbatim: "Las y los estudiantes extranjeros no comunitarios no residentes y estudiantes visitantes que se matriculen por primera vez en la Universidad de Murcia deberán abonar los derechos de secretaría que correspondan, además de los precios por la prestación de servicios académicos universitarios calculados según lo indicado en el artículo 21, incrementados en un 20%." The uplift applies whether it is a first, second or subsequent enrolment. So UM DOES exercise the power the regional decree grants it — Decreto n.º 8/2024 (Región de Murcia) art. 6.5: "Las universidades podrán diferenciar el precio del crédito hasta cubrir el 100 por 100 de los costes de las enseñanzas universitarias de grado y máster cuando se trate de estudiantes extranjeros mayores de dieciocho años que no tengan la condición de residentes, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquéllos a quienes sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, sin perjuicio del principio de reciprocidad" — but it exercises it at +20 per cent, far below the 100-per-cent-of-cost ceiling that decree permits. THIS CANDIDATE IS CAUGHT BY IT: a Tunisian national with no prior Spanish residency is 'extranjero no comunitario no residente'. OLDER, DIFFERENT RULE STILL PUBLISHED ON THE SAME SITE (logged, not silently reconciled): a UM Consejo de Gobierno document of 28/09/2012 states that from curso 2013-2014 non-EU non-resident students "les serán de aplicación las tarifas fijadas para los estudiantes visitantes" (visiting-student tariffs) rather than a percentage uplift. The current rules page governs; the 2012 document is retained because it is still live on um.es and a human should ask postgrado@um.es which tariff is actually billed.
entry_requirements: DISQUALIFYING FOR THIS CANDIDATE. The official 'Requisitos de acceso y criterios de admisión' document restricts the entry profile to music qualifications, verbatim: "Los alumnos podrán acceder al 'Máster Universitario en Investigación Musical' estando en posesión de titulaciones oficiales cuyos perfiles más adecuados serían las licenciaturas y/o diplomaturas relacionadas con la totalidad de los perfiles musicales, en particular: Títulos Superiores en cualquier especialidad realizados y finalizados en los Conservatorios Superiores de Música de España... También la Licenciatura en Historia y Ciencias de la Música (antigua Musicología), Diplomaturas relacionadas con la música en particular Maestro Especialista en Música, o sus equivalentes extranjeros... De igual modo, tendrán acceso quienes hayan cursado el título de Grado en Educación Primaria Mención en Música." The only widening is: "De igual forma se podrá reservar 4 plazas, cuando queden vacantes de las solicitudes que están relacionadas directamente con la Música, para casos especiales de solicitantes que están indirectamente vinculados con la música como los casos de estudios de Arte Dramático". Selection when oversubscribed: expediente académico 30% / CV matched to the entry profile 50% / interview 20%, with explicit extra weight for membership of the Conservatorio Superior de Música de Murcia teaching staff. 25 places.
accepts_engineering_background: NO — EXPLICIT BY EXHAUSTIVE LIST. The access document enumerates only music (and, for 4 reserved places, dramatic-art) qualifications. A Software Engineering degree is not among them, and a working music-producer/DJ career is not an accredited 'Título Superior de Música'. Treat as effectively closed unless the Comisión Académica exercises criterion (c) 'cualquier otro criterio ... que permita constatar la idoneidad del solicitante'.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null for 4312059). No applicant-level complementos scheme is published; the access route is by qualification type, not by bridging credits.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. No programme-level rule published; the plan is 42 ECTS obligatorias + 18 TFM with zero optional credits (RUCT), leaving essentially no room.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. UM's published 2026-2027 master admission calendar (verbatim headings): Fase I - presentación de solicitudes 'Del 10 de marzo al 22 de abril'; Fase II 'Del 1 al 30 de junio'; Fase Extraordinaria 'Del 30 de julio al 3 de septiembre'. Provisional lists 30 April / 13 July / 8 September; definitive lists 12 May / 17 July / 11 September; matrícula 12-14 May / 17-20 July / 11-14 September.
application_rounds: 2026-27 Fase I: 10 March - 22 April 2026 | 2026-27 Fase II: 1 - 30 June 2026 | 2026-27 Fase Extraordinaria: 30 July - 3 September 2026
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — a non-homologated foreign degree requires the UM 'comprobación del nivel de formación equivalente' "con antelación al proceso de admisión".
admissions_contact_email: postgrado@um.es
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS = 42 obligatorias + 18 TFM (RUCT); no optional credits, no internships. MUSICOLOGY / MUSIC-RESEARCH content, not music technology: research methodology in music, musicology and ethnomusicology, history of instruments and repertoire, transcription/arrangement study, performer physiology and psychomotor development, artistic creative-performative research, and practical-analytical music research. The only technical touchpoints are CET 9 "Dominar los fundamentos físico-acústicos relacionados con la música" and CET 10 "Saber reconocer el componente matemático de la música" — acoustics and music-mathematics, NOT MIR, signal processing or machine learning.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Joint venture of the Universidad de Murcia (Facultad de Educación) and the Conservatorio Superior de Música de Murcia under an agreement with the Comunidad Autónoma de la Región de Murcia (Consejería de Educación y Cultura).
industry_links: NONE. Research/academic orientation; explicit purpose is "facilitar el acceso a la investigación y la posibilidad de iniciar estudios de doctorado".
thesis_or_internship: Trabajo Fin de Máster 18 ECTS. No internship.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Robótica, Gráficos y Visión por Computador
programme_name_en: Master in Robotics, Graphics and Computer Vision (RGCV)
institution: Universidad de Zaragoza — Escuela de Ingeniería y Arquitectura (EINA)
language_of_instruction: ENGLISH. Verbatim from the official Unizar programme page: "El objetivo del máster es proporcionar una formación de investigación, innovación y desarrollo en los ámbitos de Robótica, Gráficos y Visión por Computador. La lengua de impartición es el inglés." Corroborated by the plan de estudios, whose subject titles are all in English, and by the TFM rule: "El resultado se plasma en una memoria en forma de artículo o informe, escrito en inglés".
language_requirement: B2 English or higher, verbatim: "Para todos los títulos deberá acreditarse al menos nivel B2 de Inglés o equivalente, aunque se valorarán niveles superiores." NO Spanish requirement — Unizar's general rule only demands proof of Spanish where the master is taught in Spanish, which this one is not.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 (DECRETO del Gobierno de Aragón de 24 de junio de 2026, BOA 29/06/2026; official Unizar price table 'Enseñanzas de Máster Universitario. Precios Públicos: Curso académico 2026-2027')
non_eu_surcharge: YES — CONFIRMED, EXACTLY DOUBLE, AND UNAVOIDABLE ON A STUDENT VISA. The Unizar 2026-27 master price table has a dedicated non-EU row: for EINA masters including 'Robótica, Gráficos y Visión por Computador/Robotics, Graphics and Computer Vision' the entry reads '30,40 / 60,80' — 30,40 EUR/ECTS for 'Españoles, residentes o ciudadanos UE 1ª matrícula' and 60,80 EUR/ECTS for 'Ciudadanos no UE / Non-EU citizens. Credit price 1st. Registration' (2nd enrolment 60,76 / 121,52). Crucially, Unizar states verbatim: "La condición de residente se acreditará mediante la tarjeta de Identificación de Extranjeros (TIE) donde se indique que el tipo de permiso es por RESIDENCIA. El permiso por ESTANCIA o permiso por ESTUDIOS no es válido para acreditar la condición de residente, a efectos del pago de los precios de matrícula." A Tunisian arriving on a student visa therefore pays the non-EU rate. Unizar does publish an 'AYUDAS DE MATRÍCULA para estudiantes extranjeros no residentes' call that can offset this.
entry_requirements: Access degrees, verbatim: "Ingeniería Informática; Ingeniería Electrónica y Automática (1); Ingeniería de Tecnologías Industriales (1); Ingeniería de Tecnologías y Servicios de Telecomunicación (1); Ingeniería Mecatrónica (1); Ingeniería Eléctrica (1); Ingeniería Mecánica (1); Física (1); Matemáticas (1); Otros títulos universitarios oficiales de grado en Ingeniería o Ciencias (1, 2)". Verbatim on the (1)/(2) markers: "Para las titulaciones marcadas (1), (1, 2), para el acceso directo al Máster deberá además acreditarse: (1) 18 créditos ECTS cursados (o experiencia equivalente, por ejemplo el TFG) de programación de computadores, y (2) 18 créditos ECTS cursados (o experiencia equivalente) de matemáticas." A non-EHEA degree without homologación needs a Unizar 'autorización de acceso' resolution first (access route (e)).
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT AND UNCONDITIONAL. 'Ingeniería Informática' is the FIRST listed access degree and carries NO (1) or (2) marker, i.e. it is direct access with no programming or mathematics evidence required. This is the cleanest background match in the batch.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null for 4317156). At applicant level: NONE for a Computer Engineering graduate — the 18-ECTS programming and 18-ECTS mathematics evidence requirements apply only to the (1)/(2)-marked degrees, not to Ingeniería Informática.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND as an advanced-standing rule for a 300-ECTS degree. Unizar has a general 'Reconocimiento y Transferencia de créditos' regime (linked from academico.unizar.es). The programme does state that external internships can be credit-recognised: "El reconocimiento en créditos de la realización de prácticas externas esta limitado a un máximo de 9 ECTS y podrá realizarse en segmentos diferenciados de 3 ECTS."
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. Unizar's published 2026-2027 master admission phases (verbatim): Fase 1 (except Máster en Profesorado) 'Presentación solicitudes: 2 al 23 de marzo de 2026', definitive lists 17 April 2026, payment 20-27 April 2026; Fase 2 'Presentación solicitudes: Del 11 al 26 de junio de 2026', definitive lists 17 July 2026; Fase 3 'Presentación solicitudes: del 24 al 31 de agosto de 2026', definitive lists 14 September 2026. Enrolment windows 22-24 July 2026 and 16-17 September 2026.
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES. A non-EHEA, non-homologated degree requires a separate prior 'Solicitud de Acceso' / autorización de acceso (academico.unizar.es → 'acceso con estudios extranjeros no homologados obtenidos fuera del Espacio'), which must be resolved before the general admission application. Target Fase 1 (March).
admissions_contact_email: grado.master@unizar.es (Sección de Grado y Máster, tel. +34 976 76 10 43). Programme coordinator: Ana Cristina Murillo Arnal (Escuela de Ingeniería y Arquitectura, Calle María de Luna 3, Zaragoza, tel. 976761864).
curriculum_summary: 90 ECTS = 42 compulsory + 18 optional (internships included) + 30 TFM, spread over 3 semesters. MANDATORY (6 ECTS each): 69150 Autonomous Robots (S1), 69151 Computer Vision (S1), 69152 Machine Learning (S1), 69153 Modeling and Simulation of Appearance (S1), 69154 Programming and Architecture of Computing Systems (S1), 69155 Computational Imaging (S2), 69156 Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (S2). OPTIONAL (3 ECTS each): 69168 Fundamentals of Computing for RGCV, 69157 Virtual Reality, 69158 Applications of Deep Learning, 69159 Advanced SLAM, 69160 Multirobot Systems, 69161 Assistive Robotics, 69169 Advanced Computational Imaging, 69170 Advanced Computer Vision, 69171 Research and Innovation Activities, 69164/69165/69166 Professional Internships 1-3. 69167 Trabajo Fin de Máster 30 ECTS (S3). Verbatim: "El título consta de 90 créditos ECTS en total... las materias obligatorias suponen 42 créditos ECTS, 18 créditos corresponden a materias optativas, incluyendo la realización de prácticas externas, y los 30 créditos ECTS restantes corresponden al Trabajo Fin de Máster."
notable_faculty_or_lab: Two internationally leading Unizar groups, described verbatim on the page: the Grupo de Robótica, Percepción y Tiempo Real — "el grupo de investigación de España con mayor impacto internacional en el ámbito de la robótica y uno de los de mayor impacto de Europa... incluyendo siete de los diez artículos más citados de la robótica española" (J.D. Tardós, J.M. Martínez Montiel — ORB-SLAM lineage); and the Graphics and Imaging Lab, which "ha recibido una de las pocas ERC Consolidator Grants de la Unión Europea en temas de informática gráfica (D. Gutiérrez)" and hosts "la primera investigadora española que recibe el Eurographics Young Researcher Award (B. Masiá)". Coordinator: Ana Cristina Murillo Arnal. Feeds the Programa de Doctorado en Ingeniería de Sistemas e Informática (I3A).
industry_links: Exceptionally strong and named on the page. Collaborating companies, verbatim: "Nacionales: Ábaco Digital, Atria Innovation, BitBrain, Exovite, Buavi (antes EyeLinx), Gas Natural, Indra, Sistemas, Infaimón, IT Corporate, Libelium, Robotnik, Scati Labs, Solid Angle, Tecnitop, Telnet. Internacionales: Adobe, Alibaba, Boeing, Disney, Epic Games, Google, Infineon, Kuka, Meta, Microsoft, nuTonomy, Nvidia, Oculus VR, Panasonic." Later additions include Amazon, Ericsson, German Aerospace Center, Intel, Leica, Orbem, Qualcomm, Voca. Recent doctoral graduates placed at Google, Adobe, Nvidia, Intel, Disney Research, Oculus VR, ETH Zurich, EPFL.
thesis_or_internship: TFM 30 ECTS (S3), written as an article/report IN ENGLISH and defended conference-style; may be done at EINA, at a partner company, or at a mobility-agreement university. Professional Internships available as 3x3 ECTS optional subjects (max 9 ECTS recognisable).

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario Erasmus Mundus en Ciencia de Datos Lingüísticos
programme_name_en: Erasmus Mundus Master in Linguistic Data Science (EMLDS / CLiDS)
institution: CONSORTIUM (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master). Spanish partner and RUCT registrant: Universidad de Zaragoza (Escuela de Ingeniería y Arquitectura). Full consortium as registered in RUCT: Universidad de Zaragoza; National University of Ireland, Galway / Ollscoil na hÉireann, Gaillimh (Ireland); Universidade Nova de Lisboa (Portugal); Università Cattolica del Sacro Cuore - Milano (Italy).
city: Mobility across Lisbon or Milan (S1), Zaragoza (S2 and S3), student's choice (S4)
official_status: máster universitario (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master — joint degree)
language_of_instruction: ENGLISH. Verbatim from the consortium site: "120 ECTS, English-taught master's programme leading to a Joint Degree".
language_requirement: Verbatim: the consortium requires "a minimum proficiency level of CEFR B2.2 (or equivalent) for admission". Exemptions for native English speakers and for applicants whose degree was "taught entirely in English"; otherwise a recognised English test result is mandatory. No Spanish requirement.
tuition_year_of_rates: Rate quoted on the consortium's Costs and Funding page as at 2026-08-25, for the full four-semester study period; the page does not label it by cohort year, and the currently advertised cohort is 2027-2029.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FOUND — and apparently none. The consortium publishes a single figure, verbatim: "The tuition fee for the full four-semester study period is €18,000.00 (can be paid in instalments)." It does NOT distinguish Programme Country from Partner Country students, unlike most EMJMs. Because this is a consortium fee, the Aragón non-EU credit-price doubling that applies to ordinary Unizar masters does NOT apply here (the EMLDS title does not appear in Unizar's 2026-27 public price table for másteres universitarios).
entry_requirements: Verbatim: applicants must have "completed a bachelor's degree from a recognised higher education institution" with "a minimum of 180 ECTS credits". No specific degree field is mandated. Documents: passport/ID; bachelor's diploma; transcript of records; CV in English; motivation letter "maximum 500 words, in English"; English proficiency certificate; two recommendation letters. language_of_instruction: CASTELLANO (Spanish) ONLY. Programme page header reads "Idioma: Castellano". The official programa confirms it subject by subject: all 15 compulsory subjects are listed with "Idiomas: Castellano" — Análisis, Simulación y Experimentación de Sistemas Mecánicos; Aprendizaje Automático Aplicado al Control Inteligente Industrial; Aprendizaje por Refuerzo; Big Data; Ciberseguridad Industrial; Hardware Específico para IAI; IA Aplicada a la Detección de Defectos y Anomalías en la Industria; Metodología de la Investigación; Programación Científica en Python; Redes Neuronales y Aprendizaje Profundo; Simulación Fluido Dinámica Computacional; Simulación y Optimización FEM de Componentes Industriales; Simulación y Optimización de Procesos de Fabricación; Simulación y Optimización de Procesos en Plantas Industriales; Visión Artificial. language_requirement: No minimum certificate is required for entry, but English and Basque certificates SCORE in admission — verbatim from the merit table: "Otros: Inglés y Euskera. tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27. Verbatim: "Los precios públicos que se aplican a estas matrículas son los aprobados por el Gobierno Vasco para el curso 2026-2027 mediante Orden de 1 de junio de 2026" (BOPV nº 113, 17 June 2026).
non_eu_surcharge: NO — with an unusually strong negative. The Basque price order for 2026-27 contains NO non-EU clause at all: a full-text search of the Orden de 1 de junio de 2026 (BOPV nº113, 17/06/2026) for 'no comunitario', 'extracomunitario' and 'Unión Europea' returns zero matches, and neither Anexo II (standard prices by experimentalidad) nor Anexo III (másteres con precio diferenciado) contains any nationality- or residence-based row. Price is set purely by experimentalidad and enrolment number. This master is NOT in the Anexo III differentiated list, so the standard Anexo II grade-3 rate (Ingeniería y Arquitectura) applies to everyone. Contrast with Aragón (Unizar) and Comunitat Valenciana (UA/UPV), which both double the price for non-EU non-residents.
entry_requirements: Titulaciones de acceso, verbatim: "(Grado en) Ingeniería Electrónica; (Grado en) Ingeniería Mecánica; (Grado en) Ingeniería Química Industrial; Grado en Ingeniería Aeroespacial; Grado en Ingeniería Electrónica Industrial y Automática; Grado en Ingeniería Informática; Grado en Ingeniería Informática de Gestión y Sistemas de Información; Grado en Ingeniería Mecatrónica; Grado en Ingeniería Robótica; Grado en Ingeniería de Energías Renovables; Grado en Ingeniería en Automoción; Grado en Ingeniería en Innovación de Procesos y Productos; Grado/Licenciatura en Ingeniería Civil; Otros grados o titulaciones equivalentes a las anteriores a criterio de la Com. complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null for 3500052). No applicant-level complementos are published for the listed access degrees.
