programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Ciencia de Datos
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Data Science
institution_type: private (public-interest foundation; official Catalan university, AQU-accredited)
language_of_instruction: SPANISH or CATALAN — NOT ENGLISH. Verbatim from the programme page header: "Idiomas: Español, Catalán" and "El mismo programa se ofrece en las dos lenguas en aulas diferentes". The two languages are separate virtual classrooms of the same programme; the applicant picks one at the access request ("En qué idioma prefieres realizar tus estudios? Español / Catalán"). There is no English-taught option.
language_requirement: English is RECOMMENDED, not required, and is a reading requirement rather than a teaching language. Verbatim under Conocimientos previos: "Se recomienda un nivel de competencia en lengua inglesa equivalente al B2 del Marco común europeo de referencia para las lenguas." Spanish (or Catalan) at study level is required in practice.
tuition_year_of_rates: Rates displayed as at 2026-08-25 for the 23 September 2026 intake, with UOC's own caveat: "Precios vigentes en el momento de formalizar la matrícula. Sujetos a revisión anual." 2027-28 rates NOT PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — EXPLICIT AND SUBSTANTIAL. UOC publishes two separate price blocks. "Precios para estudiantes de la Unión Europea": "Precio por crédito 25,82 €/cr", "Precio por crédito herramientas y recursos para el aprendizaje 18,30 €/cr", "Precio por crédito de asignaturas convalidadas 5,16 €/cr", "Precio orientativo a tiempo completo (1 año): 2.900,00 €". "Precios para estudiantes de fuera de la Unión Europea": A tiempo completo (1 año) 4.330 € (hasta 9 cuotas); A tiempo parcial (2 años) 4.840 € (hasta 17 cuotas). So a non-EU student pays 4.330 EUR against 2.900 EUR — roughly +49% (+1.430 EUR) full-time, or +1.940 EUR part-time. Caveat printed by UOC: "Precios vigentes en el momento de formalizar la matrícula. Sujetos a revisión anual" and "El precio orientativo indicado en la tabla está calculado basándose en un máster universitario de 60 créditos. El precio final de la matrícula será el resultante de su formalización efectiva."
entry_requirements: Requisitos académicos: an official university degree. UOC routes non-EHEA applicants explicitly — one of the four declared situations is "He cursado estudios universitarios oficiales en Latinoamérica o en otros países de fuera del espacio europeo de educación superior (EEES) y no tengo el título homologado", handled through the tutor after requesting access. Access request itself is free: "La solicitud de acceso es un trámite gratuito y sin compromiso". Documentation must be sent "en el plazo de los diez días siguientes a la formalización de la matrícula". RECOMMENDED ENTRY PROFILE (RD 822/2021 Anexo I knowledge fields), verbatim: "Ingeniería informática y de sistemas. Ingeniería eléctrica, ingeniería electrónica e ingeniería de la telecomunicación. Matemáticas y Estadística. Física y Astronomía. Ingeniería industrial, ingeniería mecánica, ingeniería automática, ingeniería de la organización industrial e ingeniería de la navegación. Ingeniería química, ingeniería de los materiales e ingeniería del medio natural." Verbatim on non-listed backgrounds: "Este Máster universitario en Ciencia de Datos está orientado principalmente a perfiles del ámbito de las ingenierías" — applicants from other fields are admitted only if they hold ALL of: basic mathematics (min. 150 h — probability/statistics, linear algebra); intermediate programming (min. 300 h — variables/functions, structured programming, OOP fundamentals, abstract data types); basic relational databases (min. 150 h — relational design, Entity-Relationship model, SQL); and introductory networks and computer architecture (min. 150 h — CPU/memory, operating systems, IP networks/Internet protocols, Linux at user level). "Dichos conocimientos serán evaluados por la Comisión de Admisión del máster." A preparatory course (6 subjects x 6 credits) exists for those who lack them.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT AND OPTIMAL. "Ingeniería informática y de sistemas" is the FIRST listed recommended knowledge field, and the four prior-knowledge blocks (maths, programming, databases, networks/architecture) are precisely a Software Engineering curriculum. UOC even steers non-technical applicants AWAY to a different master.
complementary_credits_required: 12 ECTS — COMPULSORY FOR EVERYONE, and this is NOT in RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null for 4316294). Verbatim from the programme's own plan de estudios: "Para obtener la titulación de máster universitario de Ciencia de datos el estudiante tiene que superar 60 créditos ECTS entre asignaturas obligatorias y optativas y, además, 12 créditos ECTS de asignaturas niveladoras de complementos de formación." And on timing: "Este máster está adaptado al nuevo RD 822/2021 y tiene la restricción de matricular obligatoriamente las dos asignaturas de complementos de formación durante el primer curso académico, preferentemente el primer semestre... No se podrá continuar los estudios hasta que no se superen los complementos. Los complementos de formación son conocimientos de grado obligatorios para titularse del master." Every study plan on the page repeats the footnote "En esta planificación no se incluyen los 12 ECTS de complementos de formación, adicionales y obligatorios para titularse." ==> THE REAL LOAD IS 72 ECTS, NOT 60, AND THE REAL COST IS HIGHER THAN THE HEADLINE.
credit_recognition_available: YES — TWO NAMED MECHANISMS, and the most explicit credit-recognition route in this batch. Verbatim: "No debéis cursar en vuestro programa de estudios las asignaturas reconocidas mediante la evaluación de estudios previos (EEP) o del reconocimiento académico de la experiencia profesional (RAEP). Una vez se han incorporado a la matrícula, los créditos reconocidos se descuentan del total de créditos que hay que cursar para obtener el título." Recognised subjects are also charged at a reduced rate: "Precio por crédito de asignaturas convalidadas: 5,16 €/cr" (against 25,82 €/cr). THIS IS THE 300-ECTS LEVER: a 300-ECTS Software Engineering degree is the natural case for EEP against the 12 ECTS of complementos and possibly against core subjects. NOT FOUND: any published cap or guarantee — the outcome is decided case by case after requesting access.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT PUBLISHED. UOC does not run fixed admission rounds — it runs semester intakes with rolling enrolment. The published next intake is "Inicio: 23 sept 2026". Access request is free and open continuously; the practical deadline is the enrolment window before each semester start. EXPECT (but do not assume) an equivalent late-September 2027 start.
application_rounds: Next published intake start: 23 September 2026 | Rolling semester enrolment; 'A tu ritmo. Matrícula semestral sin mínimo de asignaturas'
non_eu_early_round_advised: Not a round system, but YES in substance: a non-homologated non-EHEA degree must be documented through the tutor, and documentation is due "en el plazo de los diez días siguientes a la formalización de la matrícula".

programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Corporate Communication, Protocol and Events
institution_type: private (public-interest foundation; official Catalan university, AQU-accredited)
language_of_instruction: SPANISH or CATALAN — NOT ENGLISH. Verbatim header: "Idiomas: Español, Catalán" with "El mismo programa se ofrece en las dos lenguas en aulas diferentes". WAVE-1 ASSUMPTION CONFIRMED: the wave-1 record said 'Language of instruction NOT VERIFIED - assume Spanish-only unless the plan de estudios says otherwise'. Verified: Spanish/Catalan, no English. One elective carries an English title ('Lobbyism and public affairs', 'Business & entrepreneurship') but the page gives no per-subject language codes, so English delivery of those must NOT be inferred.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND — no language certificate requirement is published for this master.
tuition_year_of_rates: Rates displayed as at 2026-08-25 for the 14 October 2026 intake, with UOC's caveat "Precios vigentes en el momento de formalizar la matrícula. Sujetos a revisión anual." 2027-28 rates NOT PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: YES — EXPLICIT AND SUBSTANTIAL. UOC publishes two separate price blocks. "Precios para estudiantes de la Unión Europea": "Precio por crédito 25,82 €/cr", "Precio por crédito herramientas y recursos para el aprendizaje 18,30 €/cr", "Precio por crédito de asignaturas convalidadas 5,16 €/cr", "Precio orientativo a tiempo completo (1 año): 2.900,00 €". "Precios para estudiantes de fuera de la Unión Europea": A tiempo completo (1 año) 4.330 € (hasta 9 cuotas); A tiempo parcial (2 años) 4.840 € (hasta 17 cuotas). So a non-EU student pays 4.330 EUR against 2.900 EUR — roughly +49% (+1.430 EUR) full-time, or +1.940 EUR part-time. Caveat printed by UOC: "Precios vigentes en el momento de formalizar la matrícula. Sujetos a revisión anual" and "El precio orientativo indicado en la tabla está calculado basándose en un máster universitario de 60 créditos. El precio final de la matrícula será el resultante de su formalización efectiva."
entry_requirements: Requisitos académicos: an official university degree. UOC routes non-EHEA applicants explicitly — one of the four declared situations is "He cursado estudios universitarios oficiales en Latinoamérica o en otros países de fuera del espacio europeo de educación superior (EEES) y no tengo el título homologado", handled through the tutor after requesting access. Access request itself is free: "La solicitud de acceso es un trámite gratuito y sin compromiso". Documentation must be sent "en el plazo de los diez días siguientes a la formalización de la matrícula". Verbatim on admission criteria: "No existen criterios específicos de admisión para acceder al máster. Sin embargo, a los estudiantes que no tengan el perfil de ingreso recomendado (ámbitos de conocimiento como comunicación, protocolo, organización de eventos, relaciones institucionales, periodismo, comunicación audiovisual, publicidad y relaciones públicas, marketing, turismo, administración de empresas o titulaciones afines) deberán cursar obligatoriamente 6 créditos de complementos formativos." Recommended prior studies listed: Comunicación; Protocolo; Organización de eventos; Relaciones institucionales; Periodismo; Comunicación Audiovisual; Publicidad y Relaciones Públicas; Marketing; Turismo; Administración de Empresas; Titulaciones afines. Also admitted, verbatim: "Cualquier persona que tenga un título superior oficial que esté interesada en la comunicación y las relaciones públicas y que desarrolle su actividad profesional en estos ámbitos."
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT, but with a 6-ECTS bridging penalty. There are no specific admission criteria, and any holder of an official higher degree who works in or is interested in communication/PR is admissible — a working music producer/DJ has a defensible professional claim to the events side. However, Software Engineering is NOT in the recommended profile, so the 6 ECTS of complementos are COMPULSORY for this candidate.
complementary_credits_required: 6 ECTS — COMPULSORY FOR THIS CANDIDATE. NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null for 4315872); this comes from the programme page. Verbatim: "Con el objetivo de nivelar el bagaje formativo de los estudiantes que no son titulados en el área de ciencias sociales, descrito en el perfil de ingreso recomendado... se tendrá que cursar de forma obligatoria una asignatura de 6 créditos de complementos de formación: Conceptos y práctica de la comunicación corporativa (6 créditos)". credit_recognition_available: YES in principle — UOC's standard evaluación de estudios previos (EEP) and reconocimiento académico de la experiencia profesional (RAEP) apply, with convalidated credits charged at 5,16 EUR/cr. RAEP is notable here: documented professional experience as a working music producer/DJ and event organiser is exactly the kind of evidence RAEP is designed for. NOT FOUND: any published cap, and no programme-specific statement on this page.

institution: Universitat Politècnica de València (UPV) — awarded through its adscribed centre 'Berklee College of Music, Vlc Campus' (Berklee Valencia)
institution_type: public university title delivered by a private adscribed centre (centro adscrito). UPV is public; Berklee Valencia charges private-school tuition. Treat the money as private, the title as public.
city: València (Palau de les Arts Reina Sofía, Ciutat de les Arts i les Ciències)
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — CONFLICT FROM DISCOVERY NOW RESOLVED, both ways. (a) Berklee's own programme page states the DUAL award verbatim: "Master of Music in scoring for film, television, and video games" AND "Máster Universitario en Composición Musical para Cine, Televisión y Videojuegos" "(in affiliation with Universidad Politécnica de Valencia)". (b) UPV's own governing document proves the official title is live for the target cycle: 'OFERTA DE PLAZAS CURSO 2026/2027. TITULACIONES DE MÁSTER UNIVERSITARIO DE LA UNIVERSITAT POLITÈCNICA DE VALÈNCIA' (Núm. 2026/0034, 12/02/2026) lists row: centre "Berklee College of Music, Vlc Campus", campus VERA, Código Titulación Ministerio 4313419, Código UPV 2297, "Máster Universitario en Composición Musical para Cine, Televisión y Videojuegos (Scoring for Film, Television and Video Games)", Oferta de plazas curso 2026/27 = 40. RUCT estado: "Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA)", nivel "Máster - RD 1393/2007", MECES 3, verificación 19/09/2012, BOE 15/11/2013 / 22/07/2014 / 23/04/2019, "Resolución Favorable para la Renov. de la Acreditación (24/05/2021)" and (10/05/2017). ACTIVE, not extinguishing.
modality: presencial. Berklee: "One full academic year" delivered as "three consecutive semesters: fall, spring, and summer", the summer term "six to seven weeks in length". RUCT: 48 obligatorios + 6 optativos + 0 prácticas + 6 TFM = 60 ECTS. Berklee counts the same load in US credits: "Total Credits: 39-40" = "60 ECTS".
language_of_instruction: English. VERBATIM from the delivering centre's own page: "All classes are taught in English". CAVEAT ON PROVENANCE, per brief rule 7: this is Berklee Valencia's statement, not a Spanish-language 'idioma de impartición' line from a UPV plan de estudios — NO UPV-hosted programme page for this title could be found (www.upv.es/titulaciones/ has no entry, and the UPV master-offer service returns an empty shell), so the UPV-side wording could not be cross-checked. The whole institution operates in English and the UPV places table routes admission away from UPV, so English is not in serious doubt, but it is single-sourced.
language_requirement: HIGH — the highest English bar in this batch. Berklee graduate admission, verbatim, for "All other graduate programs" (i.e. everything except Contemporary Performance, so SFTV included): "Duolingo: 130", "TOEFL iBT: 100 (pre-January 21, 2026) or 5 (post-January 21, 2026)", "IELTS Academic: 7.5", "Cambridge CAE or higher". Required only "if first language isn't English" — so this candidate must certify. NOTE this is C1-level, well above the B2 asked by the UPC masters in this batch. No Spanish required.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026/2027 rates, published in US DOLLARS, covering "three semesters (fall, spring, summer)". Verbatim from Berklee Valencia's cost page: "Tuition $50,430"; "Comprehensive Fee $1,600"; "Nonrefundable Tuition Deposit: To be credited towards first tuition payment $2,500"; "Application Fee: Waived for Berklee alumni $150"; per-credit tuition "$1,615". SCORING-SPECIFIC: "Professional Recording Services (Scoring program only): $2,990" plus "Required Software Bundles: $700–$850 depending on program". NO EUR figure is published anywhere and NO conversion has been performed here — tuition_total_eur is deliberately null rather than an invented euro number. 2027/28 rates are NOT PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: NO DIFFERENTIATED PRICE IS PUBLISHED — and here that silence is close to dispositive rather than ambiguous, because the fee schedule states ONE tuition line for all graduate students with no nationality or residence distinction anywhere on it, unlike Spanish public tariffs which print an explicit non-resident row. The Valencian public price decree that fixes €/ECTS for UPV's own centres does not produce this figure: $50,430 for 60 ECTS is roughly 25x a Comunitat Valenciana public master price, i.e. this adscribed centre prices privately. PRACTICAL CONSEQUENCE: a non-EU student pays no surcharge here because everyone already pays private-school tuition. Recorded as NOT FOUND in the strict sense required by the brief (no explicit 'no' statement was located), but do not read that as a hidden extra cost.
entry_requirements: Berklee graduate application, verbatim requirements: online application with "statement of purpose" of "between 400 and 500 words"; résumé/CV in English; "One letter of recommendation from a professional colleague or professor (not peers)"; official undergraduate transcripts; "Credential evaluation (if educated outside US/Canada)" — REQUIRED for a Tunisian degree; English proficiency test as above; bachelor's degree diploma required before enrolment; "$150 non-refundable" application fee. PROGRAMME PORTFOLIO (verbatim, the real gate): "Scoring for Film, Television, and Video Games: Self-produced introductory video (max 3 minutes); Three original compositions for picture with scores (each under 2 minutes)". "All materials must be organized in one PDF document with links embedded". Programme profile sought: "Demonstrate a strong compositional foundation from their studies and/or professional experience", "notation competency and orchestral score-reading abilities", "passion for musical storytelling and a demonstrated aptitude for visual music". UPV offers 40 places for 2026/27.
accepts_engineering_background: FORMALLY YES, PRACTICALLY GATED — and the gate is musical, not academic. Nothing in the published requirements demands a music degree: the academic requirement is a bachelor's degree plus credential evaluation, so a Software Engineering degree is admissible on paper. But admission turns on the portfolio, and this programme's portfolio explicitly requires "Three original compositions for picture WITH SCORES" plus stated "notation competency and orchestral score-reading abilities". For a producer/DJ who does not notate, that is a hard barrier — this is the opposite situation from the AGENT-BRIEF's conservatory note, where portfolios often accept audio with no scores. EXPLICIT on the score requirement; INFERRED on the degree acceptability (no page states 'any bachelor's degree is accepted').
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT — the register's 'Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos' row is absent (null) for this title, which is not the same as 0. Berklee publishes no complementos/bridging mechanism at all; its equivalent is the portfolio screen. So: NOT FOUND at applicant level too.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. Neither the Berklee programme page, the how-to-apply page, the cost page nor UPV's places document mentions reconocimiento de créditos, advanced standing, or any exemption for a 300-ECTS entrant. The programme is a fixed 60-ECTS one-year block with only one elective slot, so there is little structural room for recognition even if it were offered. The 300 ECTS buys nothing identifiable here.
application_window_2027: Berklee publishes THREE STANDING ROUNDS BUT STATES NO YEAR on the deadlines page. Verbatim: "Early Action — Application deadline: November 1; Scholarship deadline: November 15; Admissions decisions issued by December 15"; "Regular Action — Application deadline: January 15; Scholarship deadline: February 1; Admissions decisions issued by March 15"; "Extended Action — Application deadline: March 10; Scholarship deadline: March 10; Admissions decisions issued by April 20". Also verbatim: "Scholarship application deadlines are different from the Program Application deadlines for Early and Regular action." INFERRED, NOT PUBLISHED: if the recurring pattern holds, a September 2027 start means 1 Nov 2026 / 15 Jan 2027 / 10 Mar 2027 — the Early Action deadline would be roughly two months after this record's access date. The year is not stated on the page and must be confirmed with admissionsvalencia@berklee.edu before being relied on. NOTE the UPV route is closed: UPV's 2026/27 places table marks both Berklee titles "No aplica" for 'Nº PLAZAS ADMISIBLES Fases 1 y 2' and 'Fase 3', i.e. these masters are NOT filled through UPV's ordinary preinscripción phases — you apply to Berklee.

non_eu_early_round_advised: YES, STRONGLY — and for a funding reason, not a visa one. Scholarship deadlines are attached to the round: Early Action applicants get the November 15 scholarship deadline, Regular Action the February 1 one, and by Extended Action (March 10) scholarship money has been competed for twice already. Since Berklee's list price is $50,430, the scholarship is the whole affordability question, so Early Action is effectively the only sensible round for this candidate. The credential evaluation required for a non-US/Canada degree also takes lead time.
admissions_contact_email: admissionsvalencia@berklee.edu (graduate admissions, +34 963 332 802, 09:00–17:00 Mon–Fri). Centre contact registered with UPV: infovalencia@berklee.edu.
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS / 39–40 US credits across fall, spring and a 6–7 week summer term, in three modules (verbatim): CORE MODULE — "Visual Arts and Media Languages, Orchestral Techniques, Visual Media Technology and Recording, Career Seminar, Advising"; FINAL PROJECT MODULE — "Directed Studies and Culminating Experience"; ELECTIVE MODULE — "One elective course selection". Named courses include "Advanced Scoring, Video Game Scoring Techniques, Conducting for Scoring Sessions, Advanced Dramatic Orchestration, and Recording/Editing/Mixing Techniques". PATH FIT — READ THIS CAREFULLY: the discovery note flagged it and reading the plan confirms it. This is a COMPOSITION/ORCHESTRATION master, not a sound-and-music-computing one. There is no MIR, no machine learning, no audio DSP and no programming. The only technology content is studio/recording craft ("Visual Media Technology and Recording", "Recording/Editing/Mixing Techniques"). It sits at the far edge of path A and is NOT a path-B (MIR/AI-for-music) programme despite the B cross-code carried in the RUCT backbone.
notable_faculty_or_lab: NOT FOUND on the pages read. The campus itself is the asset: Berklee Valencia occupies the Palau de les Arts Reina Sofía opera house complex and the Scoring programme buys 'Professional Recording Services' as a separately billed $2,990 line, indicating scoring-session access with live players.
industry_links: Structural rather than stated: a Berklee College of Music degree plus a Spanish official title, a scoring-session recording budget built into the fee schedule, and a "Career Seminar" inside the core module. No named industry partners were found on the pages read.

PORTFOLIO (verbatim, and it is unusually light): "Global Entertainment and Music Business: Self-produced video presenting one innovation idea (max 1 minute, YouTube unlisted)" — one minute, one idea, NO musical performance, NO scores, NO recordings required. Sought profile (verbatim): "Professional goals of working at an executive/managerial level in a company or creating a business/organization; Prior academic success; Prior knowledge in business; Good understanding of the current situation of the entertainment industry and technology; and Leadership in professional and/or academic environments." GRADUATION BAR: "minimum letter grade of B- in each course" and "a minimum GPA of 3.00". UPV offers 40 places for 2026/27.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — the most open door in this batch for a non-music-degree applicant, though INFERRED rather than stated. No music qualification, audition or notation is required anywhere in the published requirements; the entrance evidence is a 1-minute innovation-idea video plus a business/leadership profile. "Prior knowledge in business" is listed as something the ideal candidate should demonstrate, and this candidate's evidence for it would be their working music-production/DJ practice rather than coursework — that is a judgement the admissions committee makes and NO page states that a technical degree is accepted or excluded. Contrast with the sibling SFTV master, whose portfolio demands notated orchestral compositions and which is therefore effectively closed to a non-notating producer.

curriculum_summary: Page header: "Curriculum and Courses 2026-2027 Academic Year". 60 ECTS / 34–35 US credits in three modules. CORE (Módulo Troncal): MB-551 Copyright and Contract Management (3); MB-553 Music Business Finance (3); MB-575 Music Business Seminar (1, taken in both Fall and Spring); MB-563 Data Analytics in the Music Industry (3); GS-503 Graduate Career Seminar (1); GS-500 Master's Advising (0, Fall/Spring/Summer). FINAL PROJECT (Módulo TFM): one practicum tied to the chosen concentration — MB-611 Entrepreneurship (4) OR MB-621 Live (4) OR MB-623 Record (4) — plus MB-695 Culminating Experience (6). ELECTIVES (Módulo Optativas): four courses, 12 credits total (1 Fall, 2 Spring, 1 Summer), from MTI-613 Electronic Dance Music Composition (3); MB-614 The Art of Live Entertainment (3); MB-665 The Culture and Business of Emerging Technologies and New Creative Frontiers (3); MB-557 Economics of Creative Industries (3); MB-613 The Science of Artist Management (3); MB-626 A&R and Music Artistry (3); MB-555 Global Leadership and Management (3); MB-627 Globalization and Emerging Markets (3); MB-559 Publishing and Music Supervision (3); MTI-543 Studio Video Music Production (3); MB-615 The Business of Music Marketing (3); MB-550 Music Brands and Partnerships (3); GS-595 Graduate Internship (1). GS-510 Principles of Music Research (1) is optional and does NOT count toward the degree. CONCENTRATIONS (choose one, and it drives both practicum and final project): "Live Entertainment, Entrepreneurship, and Record Industry". PATH FIT — the strongest P/S match in this batch and the one that touches this candidate's own practice: the Record Industry concentration is path P almost exactly (copyright and contract management, publishing and music supervision, A&R), the Live Entertainment concentration is path S almost exactly (The Art of Live Entertainment plus the Live practicum), and 'MB-563 Data Analytics in the Music Industry' is a genuine, if small, bridge to path X/AB. 'MTI-613 Electronic Dance Music Composition' is directly relevant to a working producer/DJ. It is NOT a technology master: no DSP, no MIR, no programming.
notable_faculty_or_lab: Programme Director Emilien Moyon. Academic Committee of the Degree (verbatim): "Simone Pilon, Executive Director, Valencia Campus/Dean of Academic Affairs; Emilien Moyon, Program Director of Global Entertainment and Music Business; Alexandre Perrin, Professor; Jorge Ignacio Serrano Cobos, Universidad Politécnica de Valencia; Martina Naretto, Senior Coordinator for Academic Assessment, Records, and Registrar Services" — note the named UPV member, further evidence the UPV title is live rather than legacy. Culminating-experience jury named on the page: Alex Perrin, Pete Dyson, Grace Puluczek, Alf Olofsson, Steffen Meister, Pablo Munguia, Emilien Moyon.
industry_links: The strongest published industry linkage of any programme in this batch, verbatim: "50+ networking opportunities", "40+ guest speakers", an on-campus record label — "real-life projects such as the on-campus record label Disrupción Records" — and consulting projects "to develop creative solutions for real companies and start-ups, such as Sony Music Germany, Kobalt Music Group, FUGA, Chartmetric, Soundcharts, and Next Big Sound". Market-specific workshops are run on "the US, Japan, Sweden, Brazil, China, and France".
thesis_or_internship: BOTH, and they are distinct. Practicum (4 credits, tied to the concentration) + MB-695 Culminating Experience (6 credits) = the 14-ECTS TFM in RUCT; the culminating experience is defended before "a faculty committee comprising your advisor and two other faculty members", on a published timeline ("Semester One: propose ... Semester Two: revise and refine ... Semester Three: complete and present"; "June 5–9: Rehearsal presentations and definitive committee selection; June 19: CE documents submission (outcome and reflective); June 21-30: final presentation"). Separately there is "an optional internship that takes place the fall AFTER graduation for those who want to do an internship through Berklee for credit" (GS-595 Graduate Internship, 1 credit) — note it runs after the taught year, which has visa implications a human must check. RUCT records prácticas externas = 0, consistent with the internship being optional.

official_status: máster universitario (official, Conjunto Internacional). RUCT estado: 'Publicado en B.O.E.'; nivel académico Máster - RD 1393/2007, MECES 3; fecha de verificación 11/03/2021; BOE 15/01/2022. The UPV programme page additionally states 'Title in the process of renewal'.

non_eu_surcharge: YES — CONFIRMED, and it is a 100% surcharge (double price). UPV tariff sheet, section 'Precios públicos para el estudiantado extranjero', verbatim: 'Al estudiantado de nuevo ingreso extranjero, que no tenga la condición de residente, excluidos los nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquellos a quienes les sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, se les aplicará el doble de los precios públicos establecidos para cada titulación.' It also closes the residency loophole verbatim: 'la autorización de estancia concedida a los estudiantes extranjeros de acuerdo con el Real Decreto 557/2011 ... no equivaldrá a la condición de residentes.' Base Erasmus Mundus rate 39.27 EUR/credit -> 78.54 EUR/credit for a Tunisian non-resident. ARITHMETIC: 39.27 x 2 = 78.54; 78.54 x 120 = 9,424.80. The UPV programme page quotes only the undoubled figure (39.27 EUR/credit = 4,712.40 for 120 credits, 'for both Type 1 and Type 2 students'), which does NOT reflect the non-EU doubling. NOTE: an EMJM scholarship normally covers participation costs in full — see scholarships_internal.
entry_requirements: UPV admission page: 'an official Spanish university degree or other equivalent degree issued by a higher education institution belonging to the European Higher Education Area'; a bachelor's degree in acoustics or a related field — Telecommunication, Sound and Image Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture 'or equivalent'. Selection on academic record, adequacy of prior training to the master profile, professional or research experience, and motivation. English proficiency (B2 or equivalent) required.
accepts_engineering_background: PARTIAL / RISK — INFERRED, not explicit. The named entry profiles are acoustics-adjacent engineering (telecommunications, sound & image systems, industrial, mechanical, architecture) plus 'or equivalent'. A pure Software Engineering degree is NOT named. A candidate with no acoustics/physics/signal-processing coursework is at real risk of being judged inadequate on 'adecuación de la formación al perfil del máster'. Do NOT record this as an accepted background.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos = null in the RUCT record for 4317455). The UPV admission page does not address complementos de formación. NOT FOUND at applicant level.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. Neither the UPV admission page nor the consortium site addresses reconocimiento de créditos or advanced standing for a 300-ECTS entrant. UPV publishes a fee for 'Estudio de solicitudes de convalidación de asignaturas o de reconocimiento de créditos correspondiente a estudios extranjeros' (143,73 EUR), which shows the procedure exists, but no programme-level rule was found.
application_window_2027: NOT FOUND for the September 2027 intake — and there is a serious prior question about whether the programme will recruit at all. THE DECISIVE FACT: the consortium site master-waves.eu states that as of 1 October 2025 'it has been decided not to open the recruitment campaign for a 2026-2028 cohort', and the application platform (application.master-waves.eu) is unavailable. No statement was found either way about a 2027-2029 cohort. Separately, UPV publishes its OWN pre-registration calendar for the Spanish title; the most recent published calendar is for the 2026-27 intake, NOT 2027-28: 'Phase 0 (international students outside EU): November 17, 2025 - February 13, 2026; Phase 1 (all students): March 2 - April 30, 2026; Phase 2: June 15-26, 2026; Phase 3: July 31-August 7 and August 24-September 4, 2026.' These are 2026-27 dates recorded as such; the 2027-28 equivalents are not yet published and MUST NOT be assumed to be the same dates shifted by one year. ACTION FOR A HUMAN: contact the consortium before planning on this programme.

city: Madrid (seat) — taught fully at a distance

English appears only through bibliography and videos of international experts. This programme is NOT accessible to a candidate at Spanish A0/A1 and would require at least B2 by September 2027.
language_requirement: Spanish is the vehicular language of every subject. English is only RECOMMENDED, verbatim: 'Se recomienda que los alumnos del máster tengan el nivel B1' (B1 English). No Spanish certificate requirement is stated, but the teaching language makes B2 Spanish a practical necessity.
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 — Orden CNU/573/2026, de 4 de junio (BOE-A-2026-12413), Anexo II.2, row 'MÁSTER UNIVERSITARIO EN INGENIERÍA Y CIENCIA DE DATOS', rama Ingeniería y Arquitectura: 31,40 EUR first enrolment (50,70 second, 55,38 third, 58,50 fourth and subsequent).
non_eu_surcharge: NO — AND THIS IS EXPLICIT IN LAW, NOT AN ASSUMPTION. The UNED price order for 2026-27 states verbatim, Segundo.6: 'Los precios públicos aplicables serán los mismos independientemente de la nacionalidad o el país de residencia de los estudiantes.' UNED is therefore the ONLY institution found in this batch with a statutorily nationality-blind fee. A Tunisian non-resident pays the same 31,40 EUR per ECTS as a Spanish resident. THIS IS THE CHEAPEST OFFICIAL MÁSTER UNIVERSITARIO IN THE BATCH BY A LARGE MARGIN.
entry_requirements: A degree in Computer Science / Computer Engineering or related fields; also accepted are graduates in Telecommunications, Industrial Engineering or similar, IT technicians, and graduates in Physics or Mathematics. B1 English recommended. Maximum 75 new places per year. Admission baremo: alignment of prior training (degree and credits) up to 4 points; GPA up to 4 points; other merits (CV, complementary training, languages, other degrees, publications) up to 2 points.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. Computer Science / Computer Engineering is the first-named accepted profile and scores in the top band of the admission baremo. A Software Engineering degree is directly on target.
complementary_credits_required: 0 (RUCT) — ects_complementos_formativos = 0 for 4316950, so the TITLE carries no compulsory bridging load. At APPLICANT level, however, UNED publishes six foundational subjects totalling 36 ECTS (programming, advanced data structures, networks, AI, security, statistics, databases) available to students lacking the prerequisite knowledge. A software-engineering graduate should need few or none, but this is an applicant-level assessment the admission committee makes — quoting the programme page, not RUCT.
credit_recognition_available: YES — a general UNED regime exists and is priced in the fee order: the order provides that students obtaining reconocimiento de créditos pay a set charge, and that requests for recognition above four ECTS from studies outside UNED carry a fee. No programme-specific rule on a 300-ECTS entrant was found. So: mechanism confirmed, entitlement NOT FOUND.
application_window_2027: NOT YET PUBLISHED for the 2027-28 (September 2027) intake — the UNED admission page carried no 2027-28 calendar as at 2026-08-25. THE 2026-27 CALENDAR, RECORDED AS SUCH: ordinary preinscripción for new students 'del 17 de mayo al 10 de julio de 2026'; a few masters close early on '2 de junio de 2026' (Cybersecurity, Teacher Training, General Health Psychology — Ingeniería y Ciencia de Datos is NOT among them); Industrial Engineering closes '31 de julio de 2026'. Admission committees resolve by '30 de julio de 2026'. Extraordinary period for programmes with places left: 'del 1 al 10 de septiembre de 2026'. UNED therefore runs a LATE (May-July) window, the opposite of UC3M's December opening.

That removes the single biggest timing risk a non-EU applicant faces. However the ordinary window closes 10 July, leaving little slack, and 75 places are allocated on a merit baremo rather than first-come.

programme_name_es: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería Acústica
programme_name_en: Master's Degree in Acoustic Engineering
modality: semipresencial — 'Metodología semi-presencial'; face-to-face activity is concentrated in one or two afternoons a week, late October to June, at the ETSIT.
language_of_instruction: Spanish (castellano) — UNCONFIRMED BY AN EXPLICIT 'idioma de impartición' STATEMENT. No such statement exists on the UMA programme pages opened; the Visión General page carries only the site-wide notice 'El contenido original está en español', and all asignatura names and guías docentes are Spanish. Treat as Spanish-only. Do NOT infer English from the uma.es English interface.
language_requirement: NOT FOUND — no language certificate requirement published on the access/matriculación pages.
tuition_year_of_rates: Anexo I of Decreto 98/2023 applies 'a partir del curso académico 2023-2024' and stays in force 'en tanto no se aprueben nuevos precios públicos' (Disp. final primera, consolidated text 15/09/2025) — i.e. these are the rates currently in force and were unchanged for 2025-26. 2027-28 rates NOT YET PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: CONDITIONAL — and the condition is favourable to this candidate. Decreto 98/2023 art. 3.2 does NOT fix a non-EU price: 'El estudiantado extranjero mencionado en el apartado 1 que no sea residente en España abonará los precios ... previstos en este decreto. No obstante, las universidades en que se matricule podrán establecer una variación en el precio de los créditos en cualquier nivel de estudios, sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del 100% del coste del servicio académico'. Andalucía therefore behaves like Cataluña/Asturias — the real figure is on the UNIVERSITY's tariff. UMA's own máster tariff annex resolves it: the ordinary rates apply provisionally to foreign nationals over 18 who hold neither residency NOR 'la autorización de estancia por estudios' — i.e. a student stay authorisation is EXPRESSLY sufficient to keep the ordinary rate at UMA (unlike Catalonia's Decret, where a long-stay study authorisation explicitly does not equal residency). Proof must be filed at the Centre's Secretaría before 1 November; otherwise UMA issues 'una liquidación complementaria que podrá alcanzar el 100% del coste real de la prestación de los citados servicios'. CAVEAT: the tariff annex read carries the 2023/24 heading; the residency clause is standard UMA boilerplate but the 2027-28 wording is unverified.
entry_requirements: Access per the Distrito Único Andaluz rules. Holders of foreign (non-EHEA) degrees may enter WITHOUT homologación: 'los titulados de sistemas educativos extranjeros ... podrán acceder a este Máster sin necesidad de la homologación de sus títulos, previa comprobación de que acreditan un nivel de formación equivalente a los correspondientes títulos españoles y que facultan en el país expedidor del título para el acceso a estudios de posgrado'. Where demand exceeds places, selection weighs prior academic training, professional experience, a possible (remote) interview, and real availability for the in-person sessions.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT for the engineering family. The perfil de ingreso names 'recién graduado en el contexto de las telecomunicaciones' (Ingeniería de Sonido e Imagen) as the core profile and additionally admits graduates of architecture, industrial engineering, environmental sciences and health engineering. A Software Engineering degree is NOT named on that list — it is an engineering degree but not one of the enumerated profiles, so admission is plausible but NOT explicitly guaranteed. Flag as INFERRED for this specific background.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos is null in the RUCT record — the register does not publish the row; this is NOT the same as 0). No complementos de formación are mentioned on the UMA Visión General or Contenidos pages either. Applicant-level complementos cannot be excluded.
credit_recognition_available: YES in principle, case by case. The Contenidos y convalidaciones page states 'Es posible que, debido a tu formación previa, puedas convalidar alguna(s) asignatura(s) del máster' and routes the applicant to the programme coordinators / UMA's general reconocimiento de créditos procedure for masters. No figure, cap or 300-ECTS-specific rule is published. The 60 ECTS comprise 6 obligatorias + 3 of 4 optativas + prácticas + TFM, so the recognisable surface is the taught subjects only.
application_window_2027: 2027-28 dates NOT YET PUBLISHED. Distrito Único Andaluz calendar for 2026-27 (the closest published cycle): FASE 1, RESERVED FOR INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS — applications 13–29 January 2026, adjudication lists 19 February, 12 March and 9 April 2026. FASE 2 (ordinaria, Spanish and international) — applications 17–26 June 2026, adjudications 22 July and 14 September 2026. FASE 3 — applications 8–15 September 2026, adjudications 29 September and 9 October 2026.
application_rounds: 2026-27 Fase 1 (international applicants only): 13–29 January 2026 | 2026-27 Fase 2 (ordinaria): 17–26 June 2026 | 2026-27 Fase 3: 8–15 September 2026
non_eu_early_round_advised: YES — STRONGLY, and this is structural, not advisory. Andalucía runs a dedicated FASE 1 for international applicants that closes in JANUARY, roughly eight months before the intake. A candidate targeting September 2027 should expect to apply around January 2027 in the equivalent phase. Missing it pushes you into the June ordinary phase where places compete against the domestic pool.
admissions_contact_email: NOT FOUND — the programme pages route enquiries to the UMA Servicio de Acceso (Máster) rather than publishing a programme mailbox.
curriculum_summary: 60 ECTS at the Escuela Técnica Superior de Ingeniería de Telecomunicación (ETSIT): 6 asignaturas obligatorias, 3 optativas chosen from 4, prácticas en empresas and a Trabajo Fin de Máster. RUCT breakdown: 30 obligatorios + 15 optativos + 5 prácticas + 10 TFM. Project-based, taught in afternoon blocks so it can be combined with employment. Acoustic engineering rather than music technology: relevant to path C (audio/DSP) and adjacent to A, but it is not a sound-and-music-computing programme.
notable_faculty_or_lab: ETSIT, Universidad de Málaga. Specific faculty not captured.
industry_links: Prácticas en empresas are a credited component (5 ECTS in the RUCT breakdown). The programme explicitly targets employed postgraduates seeking acoustic specialisation, which shapes the evening timetable.
thesis_or_internship: Both: prácticas en empresas (5 ECTS) + Trabajo Fin de Máster (10 ECTS).

language_of_instruction: CONFLICT. UNIA's own programme page states 'Castellano / inglés'. The Universidad de Sevilla's programme page states the language of instruction is Spanish. The UNIA folleto for 2025-26 carries no idioma statement at all and is written entirely in Spanish. Both values logged below in `conflicts`; assume Spanish is required in practice.
language_requirement: No certificate threshold published, but 'Nivel de idiomas' is a scored admission criterion worth 10% of the merit baremo (expediente académico 70%, CV 20%, idiomas 10%).
tuition_year_of_rates: 2026-27 (UNIA publishes the 886,72 EUR total against the 2026-27 edition starting 5 October 2026). Underlying per-credit rate is Anexo I of Decreto 98/2023, in force since 2023-24 until superseded. 2027-28 NOT YET PUBLISHED.
non_eu_surcharge: NOT FIXED BY THE DECREE — read the university tariff. Decreto 98/2023 art. 3.2: a non-EEA student who is not resident in Spain pays the decree prices, 'No obstante, las universidades en que se matricule podrán establecer una variación en el precio de los créditos ... sin que el precio correspondiente pueda exceder del 100% del coste del servicio académico.' Andalucía is therefore in the same family as Cataluña and Asturias: the community authorises, the university decides. NO UNIA- or US-specific non-EU tariff was located on the pages opened — that is NOT FOUND, not 'no surcharge'. NOTE the contrast within the same community: UMA publishes an express clause accepting 'la autorización de estancia por estudios' as sufficient to keep the ordinary rate; no equivalent UNIA/US clause was found, so this must be confirmed with UNIA's Oficina de Estudios de Posgrado before relying on 886,72 EUR.
entry_requirements: Official Grado/Licenciatura or equivalent, or an EHEA-level title. Preferred degrees: Biología, Bioquímica, Biotecnología, Medicina, Biomedicina, INGENIERÍA INFORMÁTICA, Ingeniería de la Salud, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física 'o cualquier otra con formación en los campos comunes entre estas disciplinas'. Other professionals demonstrating specific knowledge are considered by the Comisión de Acceso. 'No existen pruebas específicas de acceso.' Merit baremo: expediente 70% / CV 20% / idiomas 10%. Only 20 places per year. Holders of an unhomologated foreign degree go through the procedure of the Resolución de 17 de diciembre de 2024.
accepts_engineering_background: YES — EXPLICIT. 'Ingeniería Informática' is named among the titulaciones preferentes, and the programme states it is designed as much for students 'con estudios previos en informática, matemáticas o física' as for biologists. A Software Engineering graduate is squarely in the intended computational intake. However only 20 places exist and the baremo is 70% academic record.
complementary_credits_required: NOT PUBLISHED IN RUCT (ects_complementos_formativos is null — the register does not publish the row; NOT the same as 0). BUT the programme has an INTERNAL bridging mechanism instead: Módulo I contains two mutually exclusive 7-ECTS optatives taken 'según formación previa' — 'Fundamentos Matemático/Computacionales' for the biologists and 'Fundamentos de Biología Molecular, Celular y Fisiología' for the computer scientists. A software engineer would take the biology one. This is a credited part of the 60 ECTS, not extra complementos, so it costs no additional credits or money.
credit_recognition_available: NOT FOUND. Nothing on reconocimiento de créditos or advanced standing for a 300-ECTS entrant was published on the UNIA or US programme pages or the folleto. Note that the bridging optative is assigned by prior background rather than waived, so a computing graduate does not shorten the programme — they redirect 7 ECTS into biology fundamentals.

non_eu_surcharge: YES — AND IT APPLIES TO THIS CANDIDATE. Two-step mechanism. (1) Decreto 45/2026 art. 1.2 does NOT fix a non-EU price; it authorises the university: 'La Universidad de Oviedo podrá diferenciar el precio del crédito cuando se trate de personas extranjeras mayores de dieciocho años que no tengan la condición de residentes, excluidas las nacionales de Estados miembros de la Unión Europea y aquellas a quienes sea de aplicación el régimen comunitario, sin perjuicio del principio de reciprocidad. ... En ambos casos, el precio de la matrícula podrá cubrir hasta el 100% de los costes de las enseñanzas universitarias de Grado y de Máster Universitario.' (2) Uniovi exercises that power and publishes the exemption list: 'para extranjeros no residentes en Estados miembros de la Unión Europea, ni de nacionalidad de países iberomericanos, Haití, Guinea Ecuatorial o Marruecos, el precio del crédito podrá variar'. THE LIST IS THE DECISIVE DETAIL: it exempts MOROCCO but NOT TUNISIA. Ibero-America, Haiti, Equatorial Guinea, Morocco, China, Norway, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Andorra and Iceland are named; Tunisia is on none of them. A Tunisian national without Spanish residency therefore pays the differentiated rate, published as 45,10 EUR/crédito against 21,84 EUR/crédito for exempt students — a 2.06x multiplier. PROVENANCE: the exemption list and the differentiation rule are quoted from the Uniovi CEI precios page itself; the paired figures '21,84 EUR/crédito para los estudiantes nacionales de la Unión Europea, Marruecos e Iberoamérica y 45,10 EUR/crédito para resto de estudiantes extranjeros no residentes' come from the search index rendering of Uniovi master pages, not from a table read directly — the CEI page itself calls its own figures 'orientativa a la espera del citado decreto'. non_eu_surcharge: YES — +25%, AND THE EXEMPTION LIST EXCLUDES TUNISIA. Two-step mechanism, as the brief predicts for Galicia. (1) Decreto 55/2025 / Decreto 72/2026 art. 2.5 fixes NO non-EU price: 'La universidad establecerá, mediante resolución rectoral debidamente motivada, los precios a abonar por la matrícula en estudios de grado y máster por el alumnado extranjero mayor de dieciocho años que no tenga la condición de residente', excluding EU nationals and those under the régimen comunitario, with the resolution capped at the previous year's rates. (2) The universities of the Sistema Universitario de Galicia agreed the price jointly at '25 % del coste de referencia para cada uno de los epígrafes de la tarifa primera', which in practice lands at EXACTLY 125% of the ordinary per-credit price: UDC's resolution sets 17,41 EUR/crédito for epígrafe A and 12,31 EUR/crédito for epígrafe B against ordinary 13,93 and 9,85 — i.e. a flat +25% surcharge.
